==================================================
FILE: .\Joon.txt
==================================================
{$CLEO .cs}
{$USE CLEO+}
{$USE memory}
{$USE ini}
{$USE bitwise}

0000: NOP
script_name "Y_Joon"

wait 1000

// =========================================================================
// YORIGAMI MASTER HEAP DICTIONARY (SCOPED: JOON CORE)
// =========================================================================
const
    MEM_SAVE_SLOT = 0             // Formerly 700
    MEM_INTENTIONAL_DISM = 8      // Formerly 722
    MEM_PLAYER_FORM = 12          // Formerly 725
    MEM_SHION_HANDLE = 116        // Formerly 703
    MEM_SHION_WEAPON_ID = 124     // Formerly 731
    MEM_SHION_AMMO_COUNT = 128    // Formerly 732
    MEM_JOON_STASH_WEAPON = 136   // Formerly 738
    MEM_JOON_STASH_AMMO = 140     // Formerly 739
    MEM_JOON_CIGAR_OBJ = 220      // Formerly 740
end

:Connect_To_Brain
wait 0
0AAA: 31@ = get_script_struct_named 'Y_Brain'
if
    31@ == 0 
then
    goto @Connect_To_Brain
end
000A: 31@ += 0x3C 
0A8D: 31@ = read_memory 31@ size 4 virtual_protect 0 
// 31@ NOW HOLDS THE MASTER POINTER.

0@ = 0    // Jo'on Active State: 0 = CJ, 1 = Jo'on, 2 = Shion
1@ = 0    // Last Tracked Shion Handle
4@ = -999 // Last Tracked Save Slot (-999 forces initial boot load)
5@ = 0    // Reload Latch: 0 = None, 1 = Silent Reload, 2 = Save Clothes & Reload (Freed from 30@)
7@ = 0    // Acquaintance Snapshot Heap Memory Pointer
8@ = 0    // Acquaintance Snapshot Active Flag (0 = CJ Matrix, 1 = Jo'on Neutralized)
9@ = 89   // ModifierKey (Default: 89 = Y)
10@ = 76  // SwitchKey (Default: 76 = L)
11@ = 0.0 // Last Tracked Fat Stat (float)
12@ = 0.0 // Last Tracked Muscle Stat (float)
19@ = 0   // Girlfriend Suppression State (-1 = Disabled in INI, 0 = CJ, 1 = Suppressed)
20@ = 1   // Target Armed Weapon Slot (Default: 1 = Unarmed/Fists)
29@ = 0   // Save Watchdog Reload Latch

// Share Jo'on State across scripts
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_PLAYER_FORM
0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0

gosub @Load_Joon_Settings

// Allocate 256-byte RAM cache on boot for acquaintance snapshot
0AC8: 7@ = allocate_memory_size 256

// Ensure native player-ignore flag is completely cleared
03BF: set_player $PLAYER_CHAR ignored_by_everyone 0

// Register Save Confirmation Callback (Using isolated 18@ to protect 20@ TargetSlot)
0ED1: set_script_event_save_confirmation 1 @OnSaveConfirmationCallback 18@

:Joon_MainLoop
wait 50

// Detect loading screens or player despawning to catch save reloads
if
    8256: not player $PLAYER_CHAR defined
then
    29@ = 1
    goto @Joon_MainLoop
end

// Force save watchdog to trigger 100% of the time after any load screen
if
    29@ == 1
then
    29@ = 0
    4@ = -999
end

// =========================================================================
// SAVE LOAD / BOOT AUTO-APPLY WATCHDOG (StartupPlayerCharacter)
// =========================================================================
// Read active save slot from master memory
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_SAVE_SLOT
0A8D: 2@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
if
    803B: not 2@ == 4@ // Save game loaded or fresh boot detected
then
    0085: 4@ = 2@
    0@ = 0 // Reset state: engine freshly reloaded world as CJ

    gosub @Load_Joon_Settings // Reloads keys and re-evaluates SuppressGirlfriends INI flag

    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_PLAYER_FORM
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0

    8@ = 0 // Invalidate old snapshot so new save slot baseline is captured

    0AF0: 3@ = read_int_from_ini_file "cleo\Shion.ini" section "Companion" key "StartupPlayerCharacter"
    if
        3@ < 0
    then
        3@ = 1
    end

    // Ensure Jo'on stash is read directly from disk on boot to prevent thread race
    0AD3: string_format 24@v "Slot_%d" 4@
    0AF0: 13@ = read_int_from_ini_file "cleo\savedata\ShionWeapon.ini" section 24@v key "JoWeaponID"
    if
        13@ < 0
    then
        13@ = 0
    end
    0AF0: 14@ = read_int_from_ini_file "cleo\savedata\ShionWeapon.ini" section 24@v key "JoAmmoCount"
    if
        14@ < 0
    then
        14@ = 0
    end

    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_JOON_STASH_WEAPON
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 13@ virtual_protect 0

    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_JOON_STASH_AMMO
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 14@ virtual_protect 0

    if
        3@ == 1 // Jo'on Mode
    then
        5@ = 1 // Queue Jo'on rebuild
    end
    if
        3@ == 2 // Shion Mode
    then
        5@ = 2 // Queue Shion rebuild
    end
end

// =========================================================================
// CHEAT LISTENER: TYPE "JOON" (Toggle Jo'on <-> CJ)
// =========================================================================
if
    0ADC: test_cheat "JOON"
then
    if and
        8449: not actor $PLAYER_ACTOR in_a_car // Must be on foot!
        816B: not fading
    then
        gosub @Record_Current_Weapon_Slot
        if
            0@ == 1
        then
            gosub @Revert_Player_Back_To_CJ
        else
            if
                0@ == 0
            then
                0793: save_player_clothes
            end
            if
                0@ == 2
            then
                gosub @Stash_Shion_Live_Weapon
                gosub @Restore_Joon_Stashed_Weapon
            end
            gosub @Apply_Joon_Skin_With_Banner
            gosub @Restore_Target_Weapon_Slot
        end
    end
end

// =========================================================================
// CHEAT LISTENER: TYPE "POVERTY" (Toggle Shion <-> CJ)
// =========================================================================
if
    0ADC: test_cheat "POVERTY"
then
    if and
        8449: not actor $PLAYER_ACTOR in_a_car // Must be on foot!
        816B: not fading
    then
        gosub @Record_Current_Weapon_Slot
        if
            0@ == 2
        then
            gosub @Revert_Player_Back_To_CJ
        else
            if
                0@ == 0
            then
                0793: save_player_clothes
            end
            if
                0@ == 1
            then
                gosub @Stash_Joon_Slot_Weapon
            end
            gosub @Apply_Shion_Skin_With_Banner
            gosub @Equip_Shion_Designated_Weapon
            gosub @Restore_Target_Weapon_Slot
        end
    end
end

// =========================================================================
// TAG-TEAM SWITCH LISTENER: PRESS Y + L (Swap Jo'on <-> Shion)
// =========================================================================
if and
    8449: not actor $PLAYER_ACTOR in_a_car // Must be on foot!
    816B: not fading
    8E25: not is_on_cutscene
then
    if and
        0AB0: is_key_pressed 9@  // ModifierKey (Y)
        0AB0: is_key_pressed 10@ // SwitchKey (L)
    then
        :Wait_TagSwitch_Keys_Rel
        wait 50
        if
            8256: not player $PLAYER_CHAR defined
        then
            goto @Joon_MainLoop
        end
        if or
            0AB0: is_key_pressed 9@
            0AB0: is_key_pressed 10@
        then
            goto @Wait_TagSwitch_Keys_Rel
        end

        // Record active slot prior to any stashing or model reconstruction
        gosub @Record_Current_Weapon_Slot

        if
            0@ == 1 // Currently Jo'on -> Tag to Shion
        then
            gosub @Stash_Joon_Slot_Weapon
            gosub @Apply_Shion_Skin_With_Banner
            gosub @Equip_Shion_Designated_Weapon
            gosub @Restore_Target_Weapon_Slot
        else
            if
                0@ == 2 // Currently Shion -> Tag to Jo'on
            then
                gosub @Stash_Shion_Live_Weapon
                gosub @Apply_Joon_Skin_With_Banner
                gosub @Restore_Joon_Stashed_Weapon
                gosub @Restore_Target_Weapon_Slot
            else
                // Currently CJ -> Save clothes & Switch to Jo'on
                0793: save_player_clothes
                gosub @Apply_Joon_Skin_With_Banner
                gosub @Restore_Target_Weapon_Slot
            end
        end
    end
end

// =========================================================================
// EXTERNAL FORM CHANGE LISTENER (Catches requests from SpawnShion.cs)
// =========================================================================
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_PLAYER_FORM
0A8D: 2@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
if and
    0@ == 0
    2@ == 1
    8449: not actor $PLAYER_ACTOR in_a_car
    816B: not fading
    8E25: not is_on_cutscene
then
    gosub @Record_Current_Weapon_Slot
    0793: save_player_clothes
    gosub @Apply_Joon_Skin_With_Banner
    gosub @Restore_Target_Weapon_Slot
end

// =========================================================================
// AUTO-TRANSFORM INTO JO'ON WHEN SHION IS SPAWNED / RECRUITED
// =========================================================================
// Read Live Shion Handle
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
0A8D: 2@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
if
    2@ > 0
then
    if
        803B: not 2@ == 1@ // New Shion detected!
    then
        0085: 1@ = 2@
        if and
            0@ == 0 // Only transform if currently CJ
            8449: not actor $PLAYER_ACTOR in_a_car
            816B: not fading
        then
            gosub @Record_Current_Weapon_Slot
            0793: save_player_clothes
            gosub @Apply_Joon_Skin_With_Banner
            gosub @Restore_Target_Weapon_Slot
        end
    end
else
    1@ = 0
end

// =========================================================================
// VERTEX PURGE WATCHDOG (Catches Fat/Muscle Morphing for Jo'on & Shion)
// =========================================================================
if or
    0@ == 1
    0@ == 2
then
    0653: 21@ = float_stat 21 // Live Fat Stat
    0653: 22@ = float_stat 23 // Live Muscle Stat

    0087: 23@ = 21@
    0063: 23@ -= 11@
    0097: make 23@ absolute_float

    0063: 22@ -= 12@
    0097: make 22@ absolute_float

    if or
        0021: 23@ > 0.5
        0021: 22@ > 0.5
    then
        0653: 11@ = float_stat 21
        0653: 12@ = float_stat 23

        if
            5@ == 0
        then
            0085: 5@ = 0@ // Queues 1 for Jo'on, 2 for Shion
        end
    end
end

// =========================================================================
// PROCESS PENDING RELOAD LATCH
// =========================================================================
if
    5@ > 0
then
    if and
        8449: not actor $PLAYER_ACTOR in_a_car
        816B: not fading
        8E25: not is_on_cutscene
    then
        if
            0@ == 0
        then
            0793: save_player_clothes
        end

        if
            5@ == 2
        then
            5@ = 0
            gosub @Silent_Rebuild_Shion_Model
            gosub @Equip_Shion_Designated_Weapon
            gosub @Restore_Target_Weapon_Slot
        else
            5@ = 0
            gosub @Silent_Rebuild_Joon_Model

            // If save was created while playing as Shion, restore Jo'on's stashed loadout
            0085: 30@ = 31@
            000A: 30@ += MEM_JOON_STASH_WEAPON
            0A8D: 13@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
            if
                13@ > 1
            then
                // Strip Shion's weapon that was restored by native save file
                0085: 30@ = 31@
                000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_WEAPON_ID
                0A8D: 15@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
                if
                    15@ > 1
                then
                    0555: remove_weapon 15@ from_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR
                end
                gosub @Restore_Joon_Stashed_Weapon
            end
            gosub @Restore_Target_Weapon_Slot
        end
    end
end

// =========================================================================
// GANG MATRIX WATCHDOG (Neutralizes all gangs while playing as Jo'on)
// =========================================================================
if
    0@ == 1 // Currently Jo'on
then
    if
        8@ == 0
    then
        gosub @Snapshot_And_Neutralize_Gangs
    end
else
    if
        8@ == 1
    then
        gosub @Restore_CJ_Gang_Acquaintances
    end
end

// =========================================================================
// GIRLFRIEND RADAR & CALL WATCHDOG (Suppresses Hearts & Calls in Jo'on Mode)
// =========================================================================
if
    19@ >= 0 // Feature enabled in Shion.ini (SuppressGirlfriends != 0)
then
    if
        0@ > 0 // Jo'on or Shion active
    then
        if
            19@ == 0
        then
            19@ = 1
            08BA: set $391 bit 11 // Native GTA SA girlfriend phone call & date suppression
            gosub @Hide_Girlfriend_Radar_Blips
        end
    else
        if
            19@ == 1
        then
            19@ = 0
            08C0: clear $391 bit 11 // Restore native girlfriend phone calls & date invitations
            gosub @Restore_Girlfriend_Radar_Blips
        end
    end
end

goto @Joon_MainLoop


// =========================================================================
// SUBROUTINE: APPLY JO'ON SKIN WITH BANNER
// =========================================================================
:Apply_Joon_Skin_With_Banner
0A92: create_custom_thread "Shion\FX_SwitchBurst.c" 1
gosub @Silent_Rebuild_Joon_Model

018C: play_sound 1058 at 0.0 0.0 0.0
0ADF: add_text_label "Y_JON1" text "~y~JO'ON YORIGAMI~n~~w~PESTILENCE GOD"
09C1: add_next_text_to_brief_history 1
00BA: show_text_styled GXT 'Y_JON1' time 2500 style 5
return

// =========================================================================
// SUBROUTINE: SILENT HARD VERTEX PURGE & CHILD SCRIPT LAUNCHER
// =========================================================================
:Silent_Rebuild_Joon_Model
// Clear any stuck tasks before rebuilding
0687: clear_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR task
0E96: clear_char_primary_tasks $PLAYER_ACTOR
0E97: clear_char_secondary_tasks $PLAYER_ACTOR

// Cloak player before reverting to base CJ
0D10: set_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR alpha 0

09C7: change_player $PLAYER_CHAR model_to #NULL
0794: restore_player_clothes
070D: rebuild_player $PLAYER_CHAR
01F5: $PLAYER_ACTOR = get_player_actor $PLAYER_CHAR
0D10: set_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR alpha 0 // Ensure CJ remains hidden while streaming model
0296: unload_special_actor 1
wait 50

023C: load_special_actor 'joon' as 1
038B: load_requested_models

:Wait_For_Joon_Model_Loaded
wait 0
if
    8256: not player $PLAYER_CHAR defined
then
    0296: unload_special_actor 1
    return
end
if
    823D: not special_actor 1 loaded
then
    0D10: set_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR alpha 0
    goto @Wait_For_Joon_Model_Loaded
end

// Swap cleanly to Special Actor
09C7: change_player $PLAYER_CHAR model_to #SPECIAL01
01F5: $PLAYER_ACTOR = get_player_actor $PLAYER_CHAR
0296: unload_special_actor 1

// Maintain fireproof immunity
02AB: set_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR immunities BP 0 FP 1 EP 0 CP 0 MP 0

// If switch burst effect is not active (e.g. boot/save load), restore alpha immediately
0AAA: 26@ = get_script_struct_named 'Sh_Swtc'
if
    26@ == 0
then
    0D10: set_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR alpha 255
end

// Wipe leftover stance-locks and unfreeze pad controls
0792: disembark_instantly_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR
0E96: clear_char_primary_tasks $PLAYER_ACTOR
0E97: clear_char_secondary_tasks $PLAYER_ACTOR
01B4: set_player $PLAYER_CHAR can_move 1

0653: 11@ = float_stat 21
0653: 12@ = float_stat 23

// Voice muting configuration
6@ = 0
0AF0: 6@ = read_int_from_ini_file "cleo\Shion.ini" section "Companion" key "MuteCharacterVoice"
if
    6@ < 0
then
    6@ = 1
end

if
    6@ == 1
then
    0489: set_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR muted 1
    094E: set_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR mute_pain_audio 1
else
    0489: set_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR muted 0
    094F: enable_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR pain_audio
end

0@ = 1

0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_PLAYER_FORM
0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 1 virtual_protect 0

// Launch Jo'on's exclusive idle smoking child thread cleanly
gosub @Terminate_Joon_Smoking_Safely
0A92: create_custom_thread "Shion\JoonSmoke.c"
return

// =========================================================================
// SUBROUTINE: REVERT BACK TO NORMAL CJ
// =========================================================================
:Revert_Player_Back_To_CJ
if
    0@ == 2
then
    gosub @Stash_Shion_Live_Weapon
    gosub @Restore_Joon_Stashed_Weapon
end

// Terminate smoking thread and cleanly destroy attached cigar object
gosub @Terminate_Joon_Smoking_Safely

// Clear tasks prior to clothes restoration
0792: disembark_instantly_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR
0E96: clear_char_primary_tasks $PLAYER_ACTOR
0E97: clear_char_secondary_tasks $PLAYER_ACTOR

// Revert model to CJ and force full opacity
09C7: change_player $PLAYER_CHAR model_to #NULL
0794: restore_player_clothes
070D: rebuild_player $PLAYER_CHAR
01F5: $PLAYER_ACTOR = get_player_actor $PLAYER_CHAR // Re-acquire fresh actor handle!
0D10: set_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR alpha 255              // Restore 100% visibility!

// CJ keeps fireproof because by praying to the Yorigami, he is blessed
02AB: set_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR immunities BP 0 FP 1 EP 0 CP 0 MP 0

// Wipe any leftover stance-locks and unfreeze pad controls
0792: disembark_instantly_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR
0E96: clear_char_primary_tasks $PLAYER_ACTOR
0E97: clear_char_secondary_tasks $PLAYER_ACTOR
01B4: set_player $PLAYER_CHAR can_move 1

0489: set_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR muted 0
094F: enable_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR pain_audio

// Restore CJ's storyline gang hostility matrix immediately
gosub @Restore_CJ_Gang_Acquaintances

0@ = 0

0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_PLAYER_FORM
0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0

// =========================================================================
// DISMISS SHION COMPANION (Shion does not recognize CJ)
// =========================================================================
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
0A8D: 25@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
if
    25@ > 0 // Solid Ped Form
then
    if and
        056D: actor 25@ defined
        8118: not actor 25@ dead
    then
        0085: 30@ = 31@
        000A: 30@ += MEM_INTENTIONAL_DISM
        0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 1 virtual_protect 0 // Set intentional dismissal flag

        07AF: 24@ = player $PLAYER_CHAR group
        06C9: remove_actor 25@ from_group
        0687: clear_actor 25@ task
        0E96: clear_char_primary_tasks 25@
        0E97: clear_char_secondary_tasks 25@
        05DE: AS_actor 25@ walk_around_ped_path
        01C2: remove_references_to_actor 25@

        // Display bewildered reaction line
        018C: play_sound 1058 at 0.0 0.0 0.0
        03EB: clear_small_messages_only
        0ADF: add_text_label "Y_CJDIS" text "~b~Shion: ~s~\"Wait... where'd Jo'on go? Who are you? Don't mug me, I'm broke...\""
        09C1: add_next_text_to_brief_history 1
        00BC: show_text_highpriority GXT 'Y_CJDIS' time 3500 flag 1
    end

    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0
else
    if
        25@ == -1 // Hitodama Spirit Form
    then
        0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_HitoF"
        0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_Warp"

        0085: 30@ = 31@
        000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
        0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0

        018C: play_sound 1058 at 0.0 0.0 0.0
        03EB: clear_small_messages_only
        0ADF: add_text_label "Y_CJDIH" text "~b~Shion: ~s~\"Wait... how'd she ditch me when I'm literally haunting her?!\""
        09C1: add_next_text_to_brief_history 1
        00BC: show_text_highpriority GXT 'Y_CJDIH' time 3500 flag 1
    end
end

018C: play_sound 1057 at 0.0 0.0 0.0
0ADF: add_text_label "Y_JON0" text "~s~CJ RESTORED~n~~w~NORMAL REALITY"
09C1: add_next_text_to_brief_history 1
00BA: show_text_styled GXT 'Y_JON0' time 2500 style 5
return

// =========================================================================
// SUBROUTINE: SNAPSHOT CJ GANG STATE & NEUTRALIZE GANGS
// =========================================================================
:Snapshot_And_Neutralize_Gangs
if
    8@ == 0
then
    8@ = 1

    for 25@ = 7 to 16
        // Calculate base memory offset for this gang type
        0085: 27@ = 25@
        000E: 27@ -= 7
        0012: 27@ *= 8
        005A: 27@ += 7@ // Memory address for gang to player (0)

        // Snapshot gang (25@) to player (0)
        26@ = 0
        if
            07E8: acquaintance 0 of_actors_type 25@ to_actors_type 0 set
        then
            000A: 26@ += 1
        end

        if
            07E8: acquaintance 1 of_actors_type 25@ to_actors_type 0 set
        then
            000A: 26@ += 2
        end

        if
            07E8: acquaintance 3 of_actors_type 25@ to_actors_type 0 set
        then
            000A: 26@ += 8
        end

        if
            07E8: acquaintance 4 of_actors_type 25@ to_actors_type 0 set
        then
            000A: 26@ += 16
        end

        0A8C: write_memory 27@ size 4 value 26@ virtual_protect 0

        // Snapshot gang (25@) to Grove / Shion (8)
        000A: 27@ += 4 // Memory address for gang to Grove (8)
        26@ = 0
        if
            07E8: acquaintance 0 of_actors_type 25@ to_actors_type 8 set
        then
            000A: 26@ += 1
        end

        if
            07E8: acquaintance 1 of_actors_type 25@ to_actors_type 8 set
        then
            000A: 26@ += 2
        end

        if
            07E8: acquaintance 3 of_actors_type 25@ to_actors_type 8 set
        then
            000A: 26@ += 8
        end

        if
            07E8: acquaintance 4 of_actors_type 25@ to_actors_type 8 set
        then
            000A: 26@ += 16
        end

        0A8C: write_memory 27@ size 4 value 26@ virtual_protect 0
    end
end

for 25@ = 7 to 16
    // Clear hostilities and set Like (1) of gang to player (0)
    0747: clear_acquaintance 0 of_actors_pedtype 25@ to_actors_pedtype 0
    0747: clear_acquaintance 3 of_actors_pedtype 25@ to_actors_pedtype 0
    0747: clear_acquaintance 4 of_actors_pedtype 25@ to_actors_pedtype 0
    0746: set_acquaintance 1 of_actors_pedtype 25@ to_actors_pedtype 0

    // Clear hostilities and set Like (1) of gang to Grove / Shion (8)
    0747: clear_acquaintance 3 of_actors_pedtype 25@ to_actors_pedtype 8
    0747: clear_acquaintance 4 of_actors_pedtype 25@ to_actors_pedtype 8
    0746: set_acquaintance 1 of_actors_pedtype 25@ to_actors_pedtype 8
end
return

// =========================================================================
// SUBROUTINE: RESTORE CJ STORYLINE GANG ACQUAINTANCES
// =========================================================================
:Restore_CJ_Gang_Acquaintances
if
    8@ == 1
then
    8@ = 0

    for 25@ = 7 to 16
        // Calculate base memory offset for this gang type
        0085: 27@ = 25@
        000E: 27@ -= 7
        0012: 27@ *= 8
        005A: 27@ += 7@ // Memory address for gang to player (0)

        // Clear temporary neutralized state for gang to player (0)
        0747: clear_acquaintance 0 of_actors_pedtype 25@ to_actors_pedtype 0
        0747: clear_acquaintance 1 of_actors_pedtype 25@ to_actors_pedtype 0
        0747: clear_acquaintance 3 of_actors_pedtype 25@ to_actors_pedtype 0
        0747: clear_acquaintance 4 of_actors_pedtype 25@ to_actors_pedtype 0

        // Read snapshotted acquaintance bitmask for gang to player (0)
        0A8D: 26@ = read_memory 27@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

        if
            08B7: test 26@ bit 0
        then
            0746: set_acquaintance 0 of_actors_pedtype 25@ to_actors_pedtype 0
        end

        if
            08B7: test 26@ bit 1
        then
            0746: set_acquaintance 1 of_actors_pedtype 25@ to_actors_pedtype 0
        end

        if
            08B7: test 26@ bit 3
        then
            0746: set_acquaintance 3 of_actors_pedtype 25@ to_actors_pedtype 0
        end

        if
            08B7: test 26@ bit 4
        then
            0746: set_acquaintance 4 of_actors_pedtype 25@ to_actors_pedtype 0
        end

        // Clear temporary neutralized state for gang to Grove / Shion (8)
        0747: clear_acquaintance 0 of_actors_pedtype 25@ to_actors_pedtype 8
        0747: clear_acquaintance 1 of_actors_pedtype 25@ to_actors_pedtype 8
        0747: clear_acquaintance 3 of_actors_pedtype 25@ to_actors_pedtype 8
        0747: clear_acquaintance 4 of_actors_pedtype 25@ to_actors_pedtype 8

        // Read snapshotted acquaintance bitmask for gang to Grove / Shion (8)
        000A: 27@ += 4
        0A8D: 26@ = read_memory 27@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

        if
            08B7: test 26@ bit 0
        then
            0746: set_acquaintance 0 of_actors_pedtype 25@ to_actors_pedtype 8
        end

        if
            08B7: test 26@ bit 1
        then
            0746: set_acquaintance 1 of_actors_pedtype 25@ to_actors_pedtype 8
        end

        if
            08B7: test 26@ bit 3
        then
            0746: set_acquaintance 3 of_actors_pedtype 25@ to_actors_pedtype 8
        end

        if
            08B7: test 26@ bit 4
        then
            0746: set_acquaintance 4 of_actors_pedtype 25@ to_actors_pedtype 8
        end
    end
end
return

// =========================================================================
// SUBROUTINES: GIRLFRIEND RADAR ICON HIDING (0xBA86F0)
// =========================================================================
:Hide_Girlfriend_Radar_Blips
25@ = 0xBA86F0 // CRadar::ms_RadarTrace base pool (175 entries)
for 26@ = 0 to 174
    0085: 27@ = 25@
    000A: 27@ += 0x24 // Offset to m_nRadarSprite
    0A8D: 28@ = read_memory 27@ size 1 virtual_protect 0
    if
        28@ == 21 // RADAR_SPRITE_GIRLFRIEND (Pink Heart)
    then
        0085: 27@ = 25@
        000A: 27@ += 0x25 // Offset to flags (Bit 1 = m_bInUse)
        0A8D: 28@ = read_memory 27@ size 1 virtual_protect 0
        if
            08B7: test 28@ bit 1
        then
            0085: 27@ = 25@
            000A: 27@ += 0x26 // Offset to m_nBlipDisplay (Bits 0..1)
            0A8D: 28@ = read_memory 27@ size 1 virtual_protect 0

            // Clear display bits 0 and 1 to hide blip (BLIP_DISPLAY_NEITHER)
            0B10: 28@ = 28@ AND 0xFC
            0A8C: write_memory 27@ size 1 value 28@ virtual_protect 0
        end
    end
    000A: 25@ += 40 // Next trace entry (sizeof(tRadarTrace) = 0x28)
end
return

:Restore_Girlfriend_Radar_Blips
25@ = 0xBA86F0 // CRadar::ms_RadarTrace base pool (175 entries)
for 26@ = 0 to 174
    0085: 27@ = 25@
    000A: 27@ += 0x24 // Offset to m_nRadarSprite
    0A8D: 28@ = read_memory 27@ size 1 virtual_protect 0
    if
        28@ == 21 // RADAR_SPRITE_GIRLFRIEND (Pink Heart)
    then
        0085: 27@ = 25@
        000A: 27@ += 0x25 // Offset to flags (Bit 1 = m_bInUse)
        0A8D: 28@ = read_memory 27@ size 1 virtual_protect 0
        if
            08B7: test 28@ bit 1
        then
            0085: 27@ = 25@
            000A: 27@ += 0x26 // Offset to m_nBlipDisplay (Bits 0..1)
            0A8D: 28@ = read_memory 27@ size 1 virtual_protect 0

            // Set display bits 0 and 1 to restore blip (BLIP_DISPLAY_BOTH)
            0B11: 28@ = 28@ OR 0x03
            0A8C: write_memory 27@ size 1 value 28@ virtual_protect 0
        end
    end
    000A: 25@ += 40 // Next trace entry (sizeof(tRadarTrace) = 0x28)
end
return

:Load_Joon_Settings

// Read Girlfriend Suppression Setting (Tri-state 19@: -1 = Disabled, 0 = CJ, 1 = Suppressed)

        19@ == 1

    end
    19@ = -1 // Feature disabled in INI
else
    19@ = 0 // Enable feature (Always reset to baseline 0 so reloaded saves re-suppress cleanly)
end

; Main modifier key held down for commands (Default: 89 = Y)
ModifierKey = 89

; Key to toggle Shion's stance: Peaceful (Unarmed) <-> Hostile (Sniper) (Default: 66 = B)
; Press ModifierKey + StanceKey (Y + B)
StanceKey = 66

; Key to order Shion to scavenge nearby bins/vending/carts (Default: 90 = Z)
; Press ModifierKey + ScavengeKey (Y + Z)
ScavengeKey = 90

; Key to cancel ongoing scavenging and recall Shion immediately (Default: 71 = G)
CancelScavengeKey = 71

; Key to prompt Shion for dialogue / thoughts (Default: 84 = T)
; Press ModifierKey + TalkKey (Y + T)
TalkKey = 84

; Key to toggle Shion: Material Ped <-> Hitodama Spirit Form (Default: 72 = H)
; Press ModifierKey + HitodamaKey (Y + H)
HitodamaKey = 72

; Key to swap weapons with Shion (Default: 82 = R)
; Press ModifierKey + SwapKey (Y + R)
SwapKey = 82

; Key to Perfect Possession switch between Jo'on and Shion (Default: 76 = L)
; Press ModifierKey + SwitchKey (Y + L)
SwitchKey = 76


[ChatPacing]
; Minimum seconds between ambient unprompted thoughts (Default: 90s)
MinChatDelaySeconds = 90
; Maximum seconds between ambient unprompted thoughts (Default: 150s)
MaxChatDelaySeconds = 150

; ==============================================================================
;                  ðŸ‘‘ SHION COMPANION & WALLET DRAIN SETTINGS
; ==============================================================================
[Companion]
; COMBAT RESOURCE MODE: 0 = Wallet Drain (Infinite ammo, costs cash per shot)
;                       1 = Gear Swap (Player gives weapon & ammo via TAB + Y)
CombatResourceMode =1

; (0/1) Enable Shion draining player's wallet per bullet fired. Disable and set CombatResourceMode to 0 so it doesn't drain your wallet but Shion still has infinite ammo.
EnableWalletDrain = 0

; (0/1) Play quiet cash register chime on every shot Shion fires
PlayShotCashSound =0

; (0/1) Show bankruptcy / card declined alert when out of ammo funds
ShowBankruptAlert =1

; (0/1) Enable blue Hitodama spirit flames orbiting physical Shion during combat
EnableCombatHitodamaFX =1

; STARTUP PLAYER CHARACTER: 0 = CJ, 1 = Jo'on, 2 = Shion (Default: 1)
StartupPlayerCharacter =1

; (0/1) Mute player character's speech lines and pain audio when playing as Jo'on or Shion
MuteCharacterVoice = 0

; JO'ON SMOKING IDLE SETTINGS
; (0/1) Enable Jo'on's exclusive 10-second idle smoking animation
EnableJoonSmoking =1

; Cooldown in seconds before Jo'on can smoke again after finishing
JoonSmokeCooldownSeconds = 45

; Cash cost deducted each time Jo'on smokes (Default: 1, 0 = Free)
CigaretteCost = 1

; Cooldown in seconds before Jo'on can complain about withdrawal again (Default: 90s)
WithdrawalCooldownSeconds = 90

; How many times Jo'on complains about withdrawal per game session, resets when loading the save. (Default: 3, -1 = infinitely)
MaxWithdrawalComplaints = 3

; (0/1) Suppress girlfriend phone calls and hide girlfriend map hearts while playing as Jo'on or Shion (Default: 1)
SuppressGirlfriends = 1

; (0/1) Hide model during shooting range when aiming. Only works for Jo'on or Shion.
HideModelInShootingRange = 1

; ==============================================================================
;                  ðŸ” SHION HUNGER & FOOD RUN SETTINGS (debug: type HUNGRY, FOOD, INJURED)
; ==============================================================================
[FoodRun]
; (0/1) Enable Shion getting hungry and asking for food stops
EnableFoodRuns =1

; In-game hours before Shion gets hungry (48 hours = 2 game days)
HungerIntervalHours = 48


; ==============================================================================
;                  ðŸ‘‘ SHION PIMPING MANAGEMENT SETTINGS
; ==============================================================================
[Pimping]
; (0/1) Show help box when near working girls in a 4-door car (once per session)
ShowPimpPrompt = 0


; ==============================================================================
;                  ðŸ“– SHION LORE & PROGRESSION SYSTEM
; ==============================================================================
[LoreSettings]
; (0/1) Enable episodic story conversations
EnableLore =1
; Seconds player has to press [Y] or [N] before Shion drops the topic
PromptTimeoutSeconds = 8
; Seconds Shion waits before asking again if you say [N] or ignore her (180s = 3 mins)
DeclineCooldownSeconds = 180

FILE: .\SpawnShion.txt

{$CLEO .cs}
{$USE CLEO+}
{$USE memory}
{$USE ini}

0000: NOP
script_name "SpwShion"

wait 1000

// =========================================================================
// YORIGAMI MASTER HEAP DICTIONARY (SCOPED TO SPAWNSHION)
// =========================================================================
const
    MEM_SHION_BUSY = 4            // Formerly 708
    MEM_INTENTIONAL_DISM = 8      // Formerly 722
    MEM_PLAYER_FORM = 12          // Formerly 725
    MEM_QUICK_DISM_LATCH = 16     // Formerly 737
    MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK = 20        // Formerly 765

    MEM_DURGASTRA_FLAG = 72       // Formerly 724

    MEM_SHION_HANDLE = 116        // Formerly 703
    MEM_SHION_STANCE = 120        // Formerly 721
    MEM_SHION_WEAPON_ID = 124     // Formerly 731
    MEM_SHION_AMMO_COUNT = 128    // Formerly 732
    MEM_COMBAT_RES_MODE = 132     // Formerly 733

    MEM_HITODAMA_X = 144          // Formerly 727
    MEM_HITODAMA_Y = 148          // Formerly 728
    MEM_HITODAMA_Z = 152          // Formerly 729
    MEM_SHION_PRES_HP = 160       // Formerly 735
    MEM_SHION_PRES_ARMOUR = 164   // Formerly 736

    MEM_REUNION_SIGNAL = 208      // Formerly 720
end

:Connect_To_Brain
wait 0
0AAA: 31@ = get_script_struct_named 'Y_Brain'
if
    31@ == 0 
then
    goto @Connect_To_Brain
end
000A: 31@ += 0x3C 
0A8D: 31@ = read_memory 31@ size 4 virtual_protect 0 
if
    31@ == 0
then
    goto @Connect_To_Brain
end
// 31@ NOW HOLDS THE MASTER POINTER.

// --- INITIALIZATION ---
10@ = 0 // Shion Actor Handle
9@ = 0  // Encounter State: 0 = Searching, 1 = Loitering, 2 = Recruited in Party, 3 = Reunion Chat Active, 4 = Dismissal Lockout
2@ = 0  // Active Hangout Spot ID (1 = Idlewood, 2 = Doherty, 3 = LV Strip)
3@ = 89 // MainKey (Y)
4@ = 72 // HitodamaKey (H)
5@ = 0  // Asynchronous Stance / Quip Priority Lock Timer (ms)
6@ = 0  // Hitodama Rapid Swap Rolling Window Timer (ms)
13@ = 0 // Quick Dismissal Expiration Timer (ms)
14@ = 0 // Hitodama Rapid Swap Counter
15@ = 0 // Morph Anti-Spam Cooldown Timer (ms)
8@ = 0  // Companion In Party Prior to Tag Latch (0 = No, 1 = Yes)
28@ = 0 // Dedicated Active Interior ID (int)

// Launch persistent Engines once on boot (Single instance, zero leaks!)
0A92: create_custom_thread "Shion\ShionTrack.c"
0A92: create_custom_thread "Shion\ShionLore.c"
0A92: create_custom_thread "Shion\ShionFood.c"
0A92: create_custom_thread "Shion\ShionGear.c"
0A92: create_custom_thread "Shion\Lore\loreMenu.c"
0A92: create_custom_thread "Shion\FX_ShionMoneyDanmaku.c"

// Permanently unlock 7-slot group capacity (bypasses zero-respect lockout on new games!)
08F4: set_max_group_members 7

// =========================================================================
// ENGINE PATCH: DISABLE GANG SIGN HAND ANIMATION & TEXTURE LOOKUP (0x0061AF60)
// Prevents companions from flashing out-of-character street gang signs.
// Patches CTaskSimplePlayHandSignalAnim::StartAnim to immediately return false.
// Assembly: xor al, al (0x32, 0xC0) | ret 4 (0xC2, 0x04, 0x00)
// =========================================================================
0A8C: write_memory 0x61AF60 size 1 value 0x32 virtual_protect 1
0A8C: write_memory 0x61AF61 size 1 value 0xC0 virtual_protect 1
0A8C: write_memory 0x61AF62 size 1 value 0xC2 virtual_protect 1
0A8C: write_memory 0x61AF63 size 1 value 0x04 virtual_protect 1
0A8C: write_memory 0x61AF64 size 1 value 0x00 virtual_protect 1

// Failsafe: Ensure flags start cleared on boot
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_BUSY
0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0

0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0

0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_REUNION_SIGNAL
0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0

0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_STANCE
0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0

0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_INTENTIONAL_DISM
0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0

0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_DURGASTRA_FLAG
0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0

gosub @Load_Spawn_Keys

:SpawnShion_Loop
wait 50

// Engine Safety: Pause execution if player is dead, arrested, or loading
if
    8256: not is_player_playing $PLAYER_CHAR
then
    8@ = 0 // Reset tag-switch companion latch on death or reload
    goto @SpawnShion_Loop
end

// =========================================================================
// SHION MODE WATCHDOG: SUPPRESS COMPANION WHILE PLAYER IS SHION
// =========================================================================
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_PLAYER_FORM
0A8D: 19@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
if
    19@ == 2
then
    // Check if companion exists as a solid ped (>0) OR floating Hitodama (-1)
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
    0A8D: 19@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
    if or
        10@ > 0
        19@ == -1
    then
        if
            9@ == 2 // Companion was actively in party!
        then
            8@ = 1 // Remember she was in party before player became Shion
        end

        gosub @Kill_All_Worker_Threads
        0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_HitoF"
        0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_Warp"
        if and
            10@ > 0
            056D: actor 10@ defined
        then
            009B: destroy_actor 10@
        end
        10@ = 0
        0085: 30@ = 31@
        000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
        0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0
    end
    9@ = 0
    2@ = 0
    wait 250
    goto @SpawnShion_Loop
end

// Check if player returned from Shion mode with companion previously in party
if
    8@ == 1
then
    8@ = 0 // Clear latch

    // Set Encounter State to Party Active
    9@ = 2
    10@ = 0 // In Hitodama form, no physical ped actor

    // Position Hitodama behind Jo'on's shoulder
    04C4: store_coords_to 20@ 21@ 22@ from_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR with_offset -0.60 -0.55 0.65
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_HITODAMA_X
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 20@ virtual_protect 0

    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_HITODAMA_Y
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 21@ virtual_protect 0

    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_HITODAMA_Z
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 22@ virtual_protect 0

    // Broadcast Hitodama state to shared memory
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value -1 virtual_protect 0

    // Terminate old threads to prevent duplicates, then launch Hitodama engine
    0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_HitoF"
    0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_Warp"
    0A92: create_custom_thread "Shion\FX_ShionHitodama.c"

    // Launch background threads that track and interact with Hitodama
    0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_Cmbt"
    0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Y_ShChat"
    0A92: create_custom_thread "Shion\ShionCombat.c" 10@
    0A92: create_custom_thread "Shion\ShionChat.c" 10@
end

// =========================================================================
// MASTER TIMERS TICK-DOWN (Runs unconditionally every frame)
// =========================================================================
// Quick-Dismiss Expiration Timer
if
    13@ > 0
then
    000E: 13@ -= 50
    if
        0 >= 13@
    then
        13@ = 0
        0085: 30@ = 31@
        000A: 30@ += MEM_QUICK_DISM_LATCH
        0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0
    end
end

// Hitodama Rapid Swap Rolling Window Timer
if
    6@ > 0
then
    000E: 6@ -= 50
    if
        0 >= 6@
    then
        6@ = 0
        14@ = 0
    end
end

// Morph Debounce Timer
if
    15@ > 0
then
    000E: 15@ -= 50
    if
        0 >= 15@
    then
        15@ = 0
    end
end

// Asynchronous Stance / Quip Priority Lock Timer (Using isolated 5@)
if
    5@ > 0
then
    000E: 5@ -= 50
    if
        0 >= 5@
    then
        5@ = 0
        0085: 30@ = 31@
        000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
        0A8D: 26@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
        if
            26@ == 3
        then
            0085: 30@ = 31@
            000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
            0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0
        end
    end
end

// =========================================================================
// HITODAMA FORM TOGGLE LISTENER: PRESS Y + H
// =========================================================================
if and
    9@ == 2 // Active in party
    816B: not fading
    15@ == 0 // Debounce off cooldown (Ignores spammed key presses)
then
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_BUSY
    0A8D: 25@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
    if
        25@ == 0 // Only toggle when NOT busy performing actions!
    then
        if and
            0AB0: is_key_pressed 3@ // Y Key
            0AB0: is_key_pressed 4@ // H Key
        then
            :Wait_Morph_YH_Rel
            wait 50
            if or
                0AB0: is_key_pressed 3@
                0AB0: is_key_pressed 4@
            then
                goto @Wait_Morph_YH_Rel
            end

            // Guard: Disallow transforming during Drive-Thru / Diner sequence
            0AAA: 26@ = get_script_struct_named 'Sh_Dine'
            if
                8039: not 26@ == 0
            then
                018C: play_sound 1057 at 0.0 0.0 0.0
                0AD1: print_formatted_now "~r~Cannot transform during drive-thru!" 2000
                goto @SpawnShion_Loop
            end

            0085: 30@ = 31@
            000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
            0A8D: 27@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
            if
                27@ >= 4 // Tier 4 Master Theater Active
            then
                018C: play_sound 1057 at 0.0 0.0 0.0
                0AD1: print_formatted_now "~r~Cannot transform right now!" 2000
                goto @SpawnShion_Loop
            end

            15@ = 750 // Apply 750ms anti-spam debounce

            0085: 30@ = 31@
            000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
            0A8D: 19@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

            // EXECUTE ACTUAL FORM SWAP
            if
                19@ > 0 // Currently Solid Ped -> Dematerialize to Hitodama Form!
            then
                gosub @Morph_Shion_To_Hitodama
                000A: 14@ += 1
                6@ = 8000
            else
                if
                    19@ == -1 // Currently Hitodama -> Rematerialize to Solid Ped!
                then
                    gosub @Morph_Shion_To_Ped
                    // Check if materialization succeeded (Var 703 became > 0)
                    0085: 30@ = 31@
                    000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
                    0A8D: 19@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
                    if
                        19@ > 0
                    then
                        000A: 14@ += 1
                        6@ = 8000
                    end
                end
            end

            // Trigger Shion's quip if she has actually swapped forms 6+ times consecutively
            if
                14@ >= 6
            then
                14@ = 0
                6@ = 0
                0085: 30@ = 31@
                000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
                0A8D: 26@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
                if
                    26@ < 4
                then
                    0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_Zone"
                    0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_Mny"
                    0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_Idle"
                    0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_Snip"
                    0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_Int"
                    0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_Veh"
                    0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_Rad"
                    0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_Sub"
                    0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_Wthr"
                    03EB: clear_small_messages_only

                    0085: 30@ = 31@
                    000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
                    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 3 virtual_protect 0
                    5@ = 2500                     // Hold lock asynchronously for 2.5s

                    018C: play_sound 1058 at 0.0 0.0 0.0
                    0ADF: add_text_label "Y_HSPM" text "~b~Shion: ~s~\"You really enjoy pushing that button, don't you, Jo'on...?\""
                    09C1: add_next_text_to_brief_history 1
                    00BC: show_text_highpriority GXT 'Y_HSPM' time 2500 flag 1
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

// =========================================================================
// AUTO-DEMATERIALIZATION ON SINGLE-SEATER VEHICLE ENTRY
// =========================================================================
if and
    9@ == 2
    00DF: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR driving
then
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
    0A8D: 19@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
    if
        19@ > 0 // Shion is currently a solid ped
    then
        03C0: 24@ = actor $PLAYER_ACTOR car
        0441: 25@ = car 24@ model
        01EA: 27@ = car 24@ max_passengers

        26@ = 0

        // Check 1: 0 Passenger capacity
        if
            27@ <= 0
        then
            26@ = 1
        end

        // Batch A: Single-seater aircraft & tank (8 models)
        if or
            25@ == 432 // Rhino Tank
            25@ == 520 // Hydra Fighter Jet
            25@ == 425 // Hunter Attack Heli
            25@ == 476 // Rustler
            25@ == 512 // Cropduster
            25@ == 513 // Stuntplane
            25@ == 469 // Sparrow
            25@ == 447 // Seasparrow
        then
            26@ = 1
        end

        // Batch B: Single-seater recreational & utility (8 models)
        if or
            25@ == 571 // Kart
            25@ == 568 // Bandito
            25@ == 471 // Quadbike
            25@ == 539 // Vortex Hovercraft
            25@ == 530 // Forklift
            25@ == 572 // Mower
            25@ == 574 // Sweeper
            25@ == 486 // Dozer
        then
            26@ = 1
        end

        // Batch C: Heavy industrial & baggage (3 models)
        if or
            25@ == 406 // Dumper
            25@ == 485 // Baggage
            25@ == 583 // Tug
        then
            26@ = 1
        end

        if
            26@ == 1
        then
            gosub @Morph_Shion_To_Hitodama
        end
    end

// =========================================================================
// RECRUITMENT STATUS WATCHDOG (Monitors ShionFollow.c Reports)
// =========================================================================

    9@ == 2
then
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE

        gosub @Kill_All_Worker_Threads // Cleanly shuts down combat, controls, and animations!

        9@ = 4 // State 4: Lockout until player leaves hangout spot
        2@ = 0
    end

// =========================================================================
// AMBIENT WORLD ENCOUNTER ENGINE (When Shion is not in party)
// =========================================================================
if
    8039: not 9@ == 2
then
    // STATE 0: SCAN FOR CLOSEST HANGOUT SPOT (Within 50m Outdoors)
    if
        9@ == 0
    then
        077E: get_active_interior 28@
        if
            28@ == 0 // Strictly outdoors!
        then
            00A0: store_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR position_to 20@ 21@ 22@

            // Spot 1: Los Santos (Idlewood behind Pizza)
            050A: 26@ = distance_between_XYZ 20@ 21@ 22@ and_XYZ 2112.7 -1822.6 13.5
            if
                26@ <= 50.0
            then
                2@ = 1
                gosub @Spawn_Ambient_Shion
            end

            // Spot 2: San Fierro (Firestation)
            if
                2@ == 0
            then
                050A: 26@ = distance_between_XYZ 20@ 21@ 22@ and_XYZ -2059.3 98.4 28.3
                if
                    26@ <= 50.0
                then
                    2@ = 2
                    gosub @Spawn_Ambient_Shion
                end
            end

            // Spot 3: Las Venturas (Old Strip Alley)
            if
                2@ == 0
            then
                050A: 26@ = distance_between_XYZ 20@ 21@ 22@ and_XYZ 2636.4 1654.8 11.0
                if
                    26@ <= 50.0
                then
                    2@ = 3
                    gosub @Spawn_Ambient_Shion
                end
            end
        end
    end

    // STATE 1: SHION IS LOITERING AT A SPOT
    if
        9@ == 1
    then
        if and
            10@ > 0
            056D: actor 10@ defined
            8118: not actor 10@ dead
        then
            00A0: store_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR position_to 20@ 21@ 22@
            00A0: store_actor 10@ position_to 23@ 24@ 25@
            050A: 26@ = distance_between_XYZ 20@ 21@ 22@ and_XYZ 23@ 24@ 25@

            if
                0021: 26@ > 80.0
            then
                0792: clear_char_tasks_immediately 10@
                04EF: release_animation "LOWRIDER"
                009B: destroy_actor 10@
                10@ = 0
                0085: 30@ = 31@
                000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
                0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0
                9@ = 0
                2@ = 0
            else
                if and
                    26@ <= 2.5
                    80DF: not actor $PLAYER_ACTOR driving
                    816B: not fading
                then
                    0AD1: print_formatted_now "~w~Press ~y~[Y]~w~ to talk to Shion." 100

                    if
                        0AB0: is_key_pressed 3@ // ModifierKey
                    then
                        :Wait_Recruit_Y_Rel
                        wait 50
                        if
                            8256: not is_player_playing $PLAYER_CHAR
                        then
                            goto @SpawnShion_Loop
                        end
                        if
                            0AB0: is_key_pressed 3@ // ModifierKey
                        then
                            goto @Wait_Recruit_Y_Rel
                        end

                        gosub @Transform_Player_To_Joon
                        0085: 30@ = 31@
                        000A: 30@ += MEM_REUNION_SIGNAL
                        0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0
                        0A92: create_custom_thread "Shion\Chat\chatReunion.c" 10@
                        9@ = 3
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            10@ = 0
            0085: 30@ = 31@
            000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
            0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0
            9@ = 0
            2@ = 0
        end
    end

    // STATE 3: REUNION CHAT IN PROGRESS
    if
        9@ == 3
    then
        0085: 30@ = 31@
        000A: 30@ += MEM_REUNION_SIGNAL
        0A8D: 25@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
        if
            25@ == 1
        then
            0085: 30@ = 31@
            000A: 30@ += MEM_REUNION_SIGNAL
            0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0
            gosub @Finish_Shion_Reunion
        else
            if or
                10@ <= 0
                856D: not actor 10@ defined
                0118: actor 10@ dead
            then
                0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_Reun"
                0085: 30@ = 31@
                000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
                0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0 // Clear Tier 4 lock on death!
                10@ = 0
                0085: 30@ = 31@
                000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
                0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0
                0085: 30@ = 31@
                000A: 30@ += MEM_REUNION_SIGNAL
                0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0
                9@ = 0
                2@ = 0
            else
                00A0: store_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR position_to 20@ 21@ 22@
                00A0: store_actor 10@ position_to 23@ 24@ 25@
                050A: 26@ = distance_between_XYZ 20@ 21@ 22@ and_XYZ 23@ 24@ 25@

                if or
                    0021: 26@ > 15.0

{$CLEO .cs}
{$USE CLEO+}
{$USE memory}

0000: NOP

script_name "Y_Brain" 

// Allocate 1024 Bytes of RAM (Supports 256 variables)
0AC8: 0@ = allocate_memory_size 1024

// Safely Zero-out the entire memory block to prevent garbage data
for 1@ = 0 to 1020 step 4
    0085: 2@ = 0@
    005A: 2@ += 1@
    0A8C: write_memory 2@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0
end

// Keep the script alive forever so the memory isn't dumped
:Brain_Loop
wait 1000
goto @Brain_Loop

const
    MEM_PLAYER_FORM = 12
    MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK = 20
    MEM_SHION_HANDLE = 116
    MEM_HITODAMA_X = 144
    MEM_HITODAMA_Y = 148
    MEM_HITODAMA_Z = 152
    MEM_SHION_PRES_HP = 160
    MEM_JOON_BASE_HP = 168
    MEM_JOON_BASE_ARMOUR = 172
    MEM_HITO_DEFLECT_TMR = 176
    MEM_HITO_SHIELD_BROKE = 180
    MEM_DMG_RECURSION_LCK = 184
    MEM_TIMES_WASTED = 300
    MEM_TIMES_BUSTED = 304
    MEM_HITO_PAIN_MUTED = 348     // Formerly unused / Spectral Shield Pain Audio Latch
end

:Connect_To_Brain
wait 0
0AAA: 31@ = get_script_struct_named 'Y_Brain'
if
    31@ == 0 
then
    goto @Connect_To_Brain
end
000A: 31@ += 0x3C 
0A8D: 31@ = read_memory 31@ size 4 virtual_protect 0 
if
    31@ == 0
then
    goto @Connect_To_Brain

0@ = 0.0    // Satellite 1 Orbit Angle (float)
1@ = 120.0  // Satellite 2 Orbit Angle (+120 deg, float)
12@ = 240.0 // Satellite 3 Orbit Angle (+240 deg, float)
16@ = 0.0   // Master Organic Wave Clock (float)

17@ = 0.0   // Current Fade Multiplier (0.0 to 1.0, float)
18@ = 1.0   // Target Fade Multiplier

2@ = 0.0    // Live World X
3@ = 0.0    // Live World Y
4@ = 0.0    // Live World Z
28@ = 0.0   // Dedicated Frame-Rate Delta Scale

0EDE: set_script_event_char_damage 1 @OnHitodamaAbsorbDamage 20@

// Initialize baseline health, armour, starting coordinates, and pain latch on boot
01F5: 29@ = get_player_actor $PLAYER_CHAR
0226: 21@ = actor 29@ health
04DD: 22@ = actor 29@ armour

0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_JOON_BASE_HP

0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_JOON_BASE_ARMOUR
0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 22@ virtual_protect 0

0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_HITO_PAIN_MUTED
0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0

04C4: store_coords_to 2@ 3@ 4@ from_actor 29@ with_offset -0.65 -0.65 0.65

:ShionHito_ChildLoop
wait 0 // 60 FPS smooth tracking

// Casualty & Arrest Telemetry while in Hitodama Form
if
    0117: player $PLAYER_CHAR wasted
then
    gosub @Restore_Pain_Audio_If_Configured

    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_TIMES_WASTED
    0A8D: 20@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

    000A: 20@ += 1

    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_TIMES_WASTED
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 20@ virtual_protect 0

    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0

    0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
end

    0741: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR busted
then
    gosub @Restore_Pain_Audio_If_Configured

    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_TIMES_BUSTED
    0A8D: 20@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

    000A: 20@ += 1

    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_TIMES_BUSTED
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 20@ virtual_protect 0

    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0

    8019: not 29@ > 0

3@ = -1 // Anti-Repetition: Last Handoff Line Index
4@ = -1 // Anti-Repetition: Last Return Line Index
11@ = 0 // Carried Object Handle

13@ = 0 // Return Subtitle Lock Release Timer (ms)

:OnShionDamage
if
    3@ == 1 // Isolated recursion lock using dedicated register 3@
then
    0ED0: return_script_event
end

if
    10@ > 0
then
    if and
        056D: actor 10@ defined

    then

            003B: 11@ == 10@
        then
            // Strictly isolated registers (4@ 5@ 6@ 9@) to prevent collision with main loop (26@ 27@ 28@ 29@)
            0EB5: get_char_damage_last_frame 11@ damager 4@ type 5@ part 6@ intensity 9@
            if
                4@ > 0
            then
                0E13: get_entity 4@ type_to 5@
                if
                    5@ == 3 // Ped
                then
                    0AEA: 4@ = ped_struct 4@ handle
                    if and
                        056D: actor 4@ defined
                        8118: not actor 4@ dead
                        87D6: not 4@ == $PLAYER_ACTOR
                        803B: not 4@ == 10@
                    then
                        0092: 9@ = float 9@ to_integer
                        if
                            9@ > 0
                        then
                            3@ = 1 // Lock callback during script damage
                            0851: set_actor 4@ decrease_health_by 9@ affect_armour 1
                            3@ = 0

                            // Spawn shion_misfortune using isolated scratch registers (5@ 6@ 9@)
                            04C4: store_coords_to 5@ 6@ 9@ from_actor 4@ with_offset 0.0 0.0 0.2
                            064B: 4@ = create_particle "shion_misfortune" at 5@ 6@ 9@ type 1
                            064C: make_particle 4@ visible
                            064F: remove_references_to_particle 4@
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
0ED0: return_script_event

{$CLEO .c}
{$USE CLEO+}
{$USE memory}
{$USE bitwise}

0000: NOP
script_name 'Sh_RedM'

0006: 10@ = -1 // 10@ = Best Target Handle (-1 = None)
13@ = 0        // 13@ = Target Type (1 = Car, 2 = Ped)
17@ = 0        // 17@ = HadTarget Combat State Flag (0 = Idle, 1 = Engaged)
18@ = 0        // 18@ = Last Tracked Player Driving State (0 = Foot, 1 = Driving)
TIMERB = 0

:TGT_MRK_CONNECT
wait 0
0AAA: 31@ = get_script_struct_named 'Y_Brain'
if
    31@ == 0
then
    goto @TGT_MRK_CONNECT
end
000A: 31@ += 0x3C
0A8D: 31@ = read_memory 31@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
if
    31@ == 0
then
    goto @TGT_MRK_CONNECT
end

:TGT_MRK_LOOP
wait 200

if
    8256: not is_player_playing $PLAYER_CHAR 
then
    goto @TGT_MRK_LOOP
end

// Read Shion's handle and stance from master heap
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += 116 // MEM_SHION_HANDLE
0A8D: 11@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

// Self-termination: Kill thread if Shion is dismissed (0) or in Hitodama form (-1)
if
    11@ <= 0
then
    0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
end

if or
    856D: not actor 11@ defined
    0118: actor 11@ dead
then
    0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
end

0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += 120 // MEM_SHION_STANCE
0A8D: 0@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

// Verify Shion is actively in Jo'on's group
07AF: 12@ = player $PLAYER_CHAR group 
if
    86EE: not actor 11@ in_group 12@
then
    goto @TGT_MRK_RESET
end

// Instant Transition Detector: Did Jo'on just enter or exit a vehicle?
19@ = 0
if
    00DF: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR driving
then
    19@ = 1
end

if
    803B: not 19@ == 18@
then
    0085: 18@ = 19@
    TIMERB = 1201 // Force immediate task update on vehicle transition!
end

// Check if currently locked target is still valid, alive, and within 100m
if
    8039: not 10@ == -1
then
    // Target is a Car
    if
        13@ == 1
    then
        if and
            056E: car 10@ defined
            8119: not car 10@ wrecked
            0EE5: locate_char_distance_to_car $PLAYER_ACTOR 10@ 100.0
        then
            if
                TIMERB > 1200
            then
                TIMERB = 0
                goto @TGT_MRK_FIND_CLOSEST
            end
            goto @TGT_MRK_LOOP
        else
            10@ = -1
            13@ = 0
        end
    end

    // Target is a Ped
    if
        13@ == 2
    then
        if and
            056D: actor 10@ defined 
            8118: not actor 10@ dead 
            0EE4: locate_char_distance_to_char $PLAYER_ACTOR 10@ 100.0
        then
            if
                TIMERB > 1200
            then
                TIMERB = 0
                goto @TGT_MRK_FIND_CLOSEST
            end
            goto @TGT_MRK_LOOP
        else
            10@ = -1
            13@ = 0
        end
    end
end

:TGT_MRK_FIND_CLOSEST
// Store player coordinates
00A0: store_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR position_to 20@ 21@ 22@

// Search parameters
23@ = 100.0 // 23@ = Minimum Distance Tracker (Only targets within 100m)
10@ = -1    // Reset target handle
13@ = 0     // Reset target type
3@ = 0      // Blip loop index (0 to 174)

:TGT_MRK_SCAN_BLIPS
0085: 4@ = 3@
0012: 4@ *= 40
000A: 4@ += 0xBA86F0 // 4@ = Blip Entry Base Address (0xBA86F0)

// 1. Check m_bInUse at offset +0x25 (Bit 1)
0085: 5@ = 4@
000A: 5@ += 0x25
0A8D: 6@ = read_memory 5@ size 1 virtual_protect 0 
if
    88B7: not test 6@ bit 1
then
    goto @TGT_MRK_NEXT_BLIP
end

// 2. Filter out Friendlies (Offset +0x25, Bit 3 = m_bFriendly)
if
    08B7: test 6@ bit 3
then
    goto @TGT_MRK_NEXT_BLIP
end

// 3. Check m_nBlipType at offset +0x26 (1 = Car, 2 = Ped)

000A: 5@ += 0x26
0A8D: 6@ = read_memory 5@ size 1 virtual_protect 0

    8039: not 6@ == 1 // Car
    8039: not 6@ == 2 // Ped
then
    goto @TGT_MRK_NEXT_BLIP
end

// 4. Check color at offset +0x00 (Must be RED: 0, 5, or 7)
0A8D: 24@ = read_memory 4@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
if and
    8039: not 24@ == 0
    8039: not 24@ == 5
    8039: not 24@ == 7
then
    goto @TGT_MRK_NEXT_BLIP
end

    8019: not 8@ > 0
then
    goto @TGT_MRK_NEXT_BLIP
end

    6@ == 1

            0085: 10@ = 8@
            13@ = 1 // Type = Car
        end
    end
end

    6@ == 2

            0085: 10@ = 8@

        end

// =========================================================================

    10@ == -1
then
    17@ = 0

end

    13@ == 1 // Car
then
    02AA: set_car 10@ immune_to_nonplayer 0
    03F5: set_car 10@ apply_damage_rules 1
end

    13@ == 2 // Ped

    02A9: set_actor 10@ immune_to_nonplayer 0

// TASK SHION EXCLUSIVELY (11@ = Shion)
// =========================================================================

// =========================================================================
// CASE A: SHION IS INSIDE A VEHICLE (PASSENGER)
// =========================================================================
if
    00DF: actor 11@ driving
then
    // Jo'on stepped out onto the street -> Shion exits vehicle
    if
        80DF: not actor $PLAYER_ACTOR driving
    then
        if
            8E4A: not is_char_exiting_any_car 11@
        then
            0633: AS_actor 11@ exit_car
        end
    else
        // Jo'on is driving -> Driveby ONLY if in Hostile Mode (0@ == 1)
        if
            0@ == 1
        then
            if
                13@ == 1 // Shoot Car
            then
                0713: actor 11@ driveby_actor -1 car 10@ point 0.0 0.0 0.0 radius 100.0 8 0 firing_rate 100
            end

            if
                13@ == 2 // Shoot Ped
            then
                0713: actor 11@ driveby_actor 10@ car -1 point 0.0 0.0 0.0 radius 100.0 8 0 firing_rate 100
            end
        end
    end
else
    // =====================================================================
    // CASE B: SHION IS ON FOOT
    // =====================================================================
    // Check if Jo'on is in a vehicle (Bike, Car, etc.)
    if
        00DF: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR driving
    then
        03C0: 28@ = actor $PLAYER_ACTOR car 
        01EA: 27@ = car 28@ max_passengers 
        01E9: 26@ = car 28@ num_passengers 

        if
            001D: 27@ > 26@ // Passenger seats available!
        then
            // Find first free passenger seat (Seat 0 on bikes/cars, up to 3)
            25@ = -1
            if
                0431: car 28@ passenger_seat_free 0
            then
                25@ = 0
            else
                if
                    0431: car 28@ passenger_seat_free 1
                then
                    25@ = 1
                else
                    if
                        0431: car 28@ passenger_seat_free 2
                    then
                        25@ = 2
                    else
                        if
                            0431: car 28@ passenger_seat_free 3
                        then
                            25@ = 3
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            if
                8039: not 25@ == -1
            then
                // PRIORITIZE boarding Jo'on's vehicle! (Runs in both Peaceful & Hostile)
                if
                    8E49: not is_char_entering_any_car 11@
                then
                    05CA: AS_actor 11@ enter_car 28@ passenger_seat 25@ time 10000
                end
            end
        else
            // Vehicle full -> Fight on foot ONLY if in Hostile Mode (0@ == 1)
            if
                0@ == 1
            then
                if
                    8E4A: not is_char_exiting_any_car 11@
                then
                    if
                        13@ == 1 // Attack Car
                    then
                        0672: AS_actor 11@ attack_car 10@
                    end

                    if
                        13@ == 2 // Kill Ped
                    then
                        05E2: AS_actor 11@ kill_actor 10@
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    else
        // Both on foot -> Combat ONLY if in Hostile Mode (0@ == 1)
        if
            0@ == 1
        then
            if
                8E4A: not is_char_exiting_any_car 11@
            then
                if
                    13@ == 1 // Attack Car
                then
                    0672: AS_actor 11@ attack_car 10@
                end

                if
                    13@ == 2 // Kill Ped
                then
                    05E2: AS_actor 11@ kill_actor 10@
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

goto @TGT_MRK_LOOP

:TGT_MRK_RESET
10@ = -1
13@ = 0
17@ = 0
goto @TGT_MRK_LOOP

==================================================
FILE: .\Shion\ShionFood.txt

{$CLEO .c}
{$USE CLEO+}
{$USE memory}
{$USE ini}

0000: NOP
script_name "Sh_Food"

// 0@ = Shion Actor Handle passed from SpawnShion.cs on boot
0085: 10@ = 0@

// =========================================================================
// YORIGAMI MASTER HEAP DICTIONARY (PRUNED TO ACTIVE SCRIPT OFFSETS)
// =========================================================================
const
    MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK = 20
    MEM_SHION_HANDLE = 116
    MEM_LAST_FED_HOURS = 228
end

:Connect_To_Brain
wait 0
0AAA: 31@ = get_script_struct_named 'Y_Brain'
if
    31@ == 0 
then
    goto @Connect_To_Brain
end
000A: 31@ += 0x3C 
0A8D: 31@ = read_memory 31@ size 4 virtual_protect 0 
// 31@ NOW HOLDS THE MASTER POINTER.

wait 1500

0@ = 0    // Food Prompt Display Latch (0 = Ready to show once, 1 = Already shown)
1@ = 0    // RAM Heap Memory Pointer for food cache
2@ = 0    // Cached Food Stop Count for active interior
3@ = -999 // Last Tracked Interior ID (-999 forces initial load)
8@ = 0    // TAB Hold Timer (ms) for on-foot
11@ = 0   // Dedicated Player Vehicle Handle
12@ = 0   // Needs Food Boolean Flag (Relocated from 31@)
13@ = 48  // HungerIntervalHours (default 48h)
14@ = 0   // Elapsed Hours Since Last Fed (Relocated from 30@)
15@ = 0   // Diner Active State: 0 = Idle/Monitoring, 1 = Diner Active
19@ = 0   // Near Food Location Boolean Flag (1 = Near, 0 = Not Near)
22@ = 0   // Shion Health Tracker (Integer)
23@ = 0   // FoodReasonFlag to pass: 1 = Hungry, 2 = Wounded, 3 = Mild Hurt
28@ = 0   // Current Active Interior ID
29@ = 0   // Current Total In-Game Hours

// Allocate 8 KB RAM Cache once on boot (Holds up to 500 custom food locations)
0AC8: 1@ = allocate_memory_size 8000

:ShionFood_Loop
wait 250

if
    8256: not is_player_playing $PLAYER_CHAR
then
    goto @ShionFood_Loop
end

// Read Live Handle from Shared Memory
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
0A8D: 10@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

// If dismissed or inactive (0), sleep cleanly without terminating (Prevents heap memory leaks!)
if
    10@ == 0
then
    0@ = 0
    8@ = 0
    wait 500
    goto @ShionFood_Loop
end

// If in Hitodama Form (-1), sleep and stay alive! (Spirits do not eat, but thread remains active!)
if
    10@ == -1
then
    0@ = 0 // Clear prompt latch
    8@ = 0 // Clear TAB timer
    wait 250
    goto @ShionFood_Loop
end

// If Solid Ped (> 0), wait cleanly if dead or undefined (Matches persistent engines!)
if or
    856D: not actor 10@ defined
