==================================================
FILE: .\Shion\ShionGear.txt
==================================================
{$CLEO .c}
{$USE CLEO+}
{$USE memory}
{$USE ini}

0000: NOP
script_name "Sh_Gear"

wait 1000

// =========================================================================
// YORIGAMI MASTER HEAP DICTIONARY (PRUNED FOR SHION GEAR)
// =========================================================================
const
    MEM_SAVE_SLOT = 0
    MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK = 20
    MEM_SHION_HANDLE = 116
    MEM_SHION_STANCE = 120
    MEM_SHION_WEAPON_ID = 124
    MEM_SHION_AMMO_COUNT = 128
    MEM_COMBAT_RES_MODE = 132
    MEM_JOON_STASH_WEAPON = 136
    MEM_JOON_STASH_AMMO = 140
end

:Connect_To_Brain
wait 0
0AAA: 31@ = get_script_struct_named 'Y_Brain'
if
    31@ == 0 
then
    goto @Connect_To_Brain
end
000A: 31@ += 0x3C 
0A8D: 31@ = read_memory 31@ size 4 virtual_protect 0 
// 31@ NOW HOLDS THE MASTER POINTER.

// Initialize persistent state registers
0@ = -999  // Current Save Slot (from 0E2C)
1@ = -999  // Last Tracked Save Slot
2@ = 89    // MainKey (Y)
3@ = 82    // SwapKey (R)
4@ = 1     // CombatResourceMode (0 = Wallet Drain, 1 = Gear Swap)
5@ = 0     // Shion Stored Weapon ID (RAM)
6@ = 0     // Shion Stored Ammo Count (RAM)
7@ = 0     // Out of Ammo Audio/Subtitle Latch Flag
8@ = 0     // Empty-Ammo Debounce Accumulator Timer (ms)
9@ = 0     // Loading Screen Watchdog Flag

// Read Settings from Shion.ini
gosub @Reload_Gear_Settings

// Load active save slot data on initial boot
0E2C: 0@ = get_current_save_slot
if
    0@ < 0
then
    0@ = 0
end
gosub @Load_Weapon_Slot_From_Ini

:ShionGear_Loop
wait 50

// Detect loading screens or player despawning to catch save reloads
if
    8256: not player $PLAYER_CHAR defined
then
    9@ = 1
    goto @ShionGear_Loop
end

// Force slot reload from disk after any loading screen
if
    9@ == 1
then
    9@ = 0
    1@ = -999
end

// Check if Save Slot Changed or Save Loaded
0E2C: 0@ = get_current_save_slot
if
    0@ < 0
then
    0@ = 0
end

if
    803B: not 0@ == 1@
then
    gosub @Load_Weapon_Slot_From_Ini
end

// Read Live Handle from Shared Memory
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
0A8D: 10@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

// If dismissed or in Hitodama form: sleep without touching actor opcodes
if
    10@ <= 0
then
    7@ = 0
    8@ = 0
    wait 250
    goto @ShionGear_Loop
end

// If physical actor is deleted or dead: sleep cleanly
if
    856D: not actor 10@ defined
then
    7@ = 0
    8@ = 0
    wait 250
    goto @ShionGear_Loop
end

if
    0118: actor 10@ dead
then
    7@ = 0
    8@ = 0
    wait 250
    goto @ShionGear_Loop
end

// Read Live Resource Mode from Shion.ini
0AF0: 4@ = read_int_from_ini_file "cleo\Shion.ini" section "Companion" key "CombatResourceMode"
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_COMBAT_RES_MODE
0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 4@ virtual_protect 0 // Broadcast mode (1 = Gear Swap, 0 = Wallet Drain)

// If Wallet Drain is active (Mode 0), Gear Swap stays dormant
if
    4@ == 0
then
    wait 250
    goto @ShionGear_Loop
end

// =========================================================================
// REAL-TIME AMMO MONITOR & EMPTY WEAPON FALLBACK WATCHDOG
// =========================================================================
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_STANCE
0A8D: 18@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0 // Stance State (0 = Peaceful/Concealed, 1 = Hostile/Armed)

0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_WEAPON_ID
0A8D: 5@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0  // Keep synced with RAM

0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_AMMO_COUNT
0A8D: 6@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0  // Keep synced with RAM

if and
    18@ == 1 // Only monitor ammo while actively in Hostile stance
    10@ > 0  // Solid Ped only
    5@ > 1   // Shion has a firearm assigned
then
    041A: 11@ = actor 10@ weapon 5@ ammo

    // Protect RAM: only update ammo count if greater than 0
    if
        11@ > 0
    then
        0085: 6@ = 11@
        0085: 30@ = 31@
        000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_AMMO_COUNT
        0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 6@ virtual_protect 0
        8@ = 0
    else
        // If ammo reports 0, ensure she is not actively firing or cycling a round
        if
            82E0: not actor 10@ firing_weapon
        then
            000A: 8@ += 50
            // Must continuously report 0 ammo for 1.5s while not firing to be truly empty
            if
                8@ >= 1500
            then
                8@ = 0
                if
                    7@ == 0
                then
                    7@ = 1
                    gosub @Execute_Shion_Out_Of_Ammo
                end
            end
        else
            8@ = 0
        end
    end
else
    7@ = 0
    8@ = 0
end

// =========================================================================
// GEAR SWAP INTERACTION CONTROLLER (Y + R on foot within 4m)
// =========================================================================
01F5: 28@ = get_player_actor $PLAYER_CHAR
if and
    10@ > 0
    80DF: not actor 28@ driving
    8449: not actor 10@ in_a_car
    816B: not fading
then
    if
        8E25: not is_on_cutscene
    then
        if and
            0AB0: is_key_pressed 2@ // Y Key (ModifierKey)
            0AB0: is_key_pressed 3@ // R Key (SwapKey)
        then
            00A0: store_actor 28@ position_to 20@ 21@ 22@
            00A0: store_actor 10@ position_to 23@ 24@ 25@
            050A: 26@ = distance_between_XYZ 20@ 21@ 22@ and_XYZ 23@ 24@ 25@

            if
                8021: not 26@ > 4.0
            then
                :Wait_Gear_Swap_Release
                wait 50
                if
                    8256: not player $PLAYER_CHAR defined
                then
                    goto @ShionGear_Loop
                end
                if or
                    0AB0: is_key_pressed 2@
                    0AB0: is_key_pressed 3@
                then
                    goto @Wait_Gear_Swap_Release
                end

                // Only allow swap if Sister Talk (Tier 4) is not holding the screen
                0085: 30@ = 31@
                000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
                0A8D: 19@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
                if
                    19@ < 4
                then
                    gosub @Execute_Weapon_Swap
                    :Wait_Post_Swap_Release
                    wait 50
                    if or
                        0AB0: is_key_pressed 2@
                        0AB0: is_key_pressed 3@
                    then
                        goto @Wait_Post_Swap_Release
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

goto @ShionGear_Loop


// =========================================================================
// SUBROUTINE: EXECUTE WEAPON SWAP
// =========================================================================
:Execute_Weapon_Swap
01F5: 28@ = get_player_actor $PLAYER_CHAR
0470: 27@ = actor 28@ current_weapon

// Sync Shion's stored weapon & ammo from RAM
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_WEAPON_ID
0A8D: 5@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_AMMO_COUNT
0A8D: 6@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_STANCE
0A8D: 18@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

// If Shion is currently in Hostile mode, ensure RAM has her live ammo
if and
    18@ == 1
    5@ > 1
    10@ > 0
then
    041A: 11@ = actor 10@ weapon 5@ ammo
    if
        11@ > 0
    then
        0085: 6@ = 11@
        0085: 30@ = 31@
        000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_AMMO_COUNT
        0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 6@ virtual_protect 0
    end
end

// Case: Jo'on is unarmed (fists or knuckles) -> Retrieve Shion's weapon & pool ammo
if
    27@ <= 1
then
    if or
        5@ <= 1
        6@ <= 0
    then
        018C: play_sound 1057 at 0.0 0.0 0.0
        03EB: clear_small_messages_only
        0ADF: add_text_label "Y_SWNO" text "~b~Shion: ~s~\"There's nothing in my hands, Jo'on... you never gave me a gun.\""
        09C1: add_next_text_to_brief_history 1
        00BC: show_text_highpriority GXT 'Y_SWNO' time 2500 flag 1
        return
    end

    // Check if Jo'on already carries ammo for this exact weapon on her person
    041A: 29@ = actor 28@ weapon 5@ ammo
    if
        29@ > 0
    then
        005A: 6@ += 29@ // Pool Jo'on's existing ammo with Shion's weapon
    else
        // Check same-slot sibling weapons if Jo'on holds a sibling variant
        gosub @Check_And_Pool_Player_Sibling_Ammo
    end

    // Strip physical weapon from Shion ped completely
    048F: actor 10@ remove_weapons
    0555: remove_weapon 5@ from_actor 10@
    01B9: set_actor 10@ armed_weapon_to 0

    // Remove any weapon remnants in that slot from Jo'on first to prevent stacking
    0555: remove_weapon 5@ from_actor 28@

    // Give weapon and pooled stored ammo to Jo'on
    0781: get_weapon_with_ID 5@ model_to 12@
    if
        12@ > 0
    then
        0247: load_model 12@
        038B: load_requested_models

        :Wait_Player_Swap_Model
        wait 0
        if
            8256: not player $PLAYER_CHAR defined
        then
            0249: release_model 12@
            return
        end
        if
            8248: not model 12@ available
        then
            goto @Wait_Player_Swap_Model
        end

        01B2: give_actor 28@ weapon 5@ ammo 6@
        01B9: set_actor 28@ armed_weapon_to 5@
        017B: set_actor 28@ weapon 5@ ammo_to 6@
        0249: release_model 12@
    end

    // Reset Shion's designated weapon and ammo in RAM
    5@ = 0
    6@ = 0
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_WEAPON_ID
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0

    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_AMMO_COUNT
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0

    // Put Shion into Peaceful Stance
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_STANCE
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0
    gosub @Apply_Shion_Peaceful_Mode

    // Play Retrieve Dialogue
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 3 virtual_protect 0
    018C: play_sound 1058 at 0.0 0.0 0.0
    03EB: clear_small_messages_only
    0ADF: add_text_label "Y_SWRE" text "~y~Jo'on: ~s~\"Hand it over! Lemme show ya how to shoot!\"~n~~b~Shion: ~w~\"Fine by me... it was rattling my wrists anyway.\""
    09C1: add_next_text_to_brief_history 1
    00BC: show_text_highpriority GXT 'Y_SWRE' time 3000 flag 1
    wait 2500
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
    0A8D: 19@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
    if
        19@ == 3
    then
        0085: 30@ = 31@
        000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
        0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0
    end
    return
end

// Case: Jo'on is armed with a firearm (Pistols through Heavy Weapons: IDs 22 to 38)
if
    27@ > 1
then
    // Reject melee weapons, thrown explosives, and special tools/gadgets
    if or
        27@ < 22
        27@ > 38
    then
        018C: play_sound 1057 at 0.0 0.0 0.0
        return
    end

    041A: 29@ = actor 28@ weapon 27@ ammo
    if
        29@ <= 0
    then
        018C: play_sound 1057 at 0.0 0.0 0.0
        03EB: clear_small_messages_only
        0ADF: add_text_label "Y_SWNE" text "~y~Jo'on: ~s~\"Tch, it's bone-dry! What am I supposed to do, chuck it at 'em?!\""
        09C1: add_next_text_to_brief_history 1
        00BC: show_text_highpriority GXT 'Y_SWNE' time 2500 flag 1
        return
    end

    // Sub-case: Shion already holds a different weapon
    if and
        5@ > 1
        6@ > 0
        803B: not 27@ == 5@
    then
        018C: play_sound 1057 at 0.0 0.0 0.0
        03EB: clear_small_messages_only
        0ADF: add_text_label "Y_SWDF" text "~b~Shion: ~s~\"I've only got two hands, Jo'on... take this one back before I drop both.\""
        09C1: add_next_text_to_brief_history 1
        00BC: show_text_highpriority GXT 'Y_SWDF' time 3000 flag 1
        return
    end

    // Sub-case: Shion has the same weapon -> pool ammo from Jo'on to Shion
    if and
        5@ > 1
        6@ > 0
        003B: 27@ == 5@
    then
        // Strip Jo'on's gun completely
        0555: remove_weapon 27@ from_actor 28@
        01B9: set_actor 28@ armed_weapon_to 0

        // Pool ammo into Shion's reserve in RAM
        005A: 6@ += 29@
        0085: 30@ = 31@
        000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_AMMO_COUNT
        0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 6@ virtual_protect 0

        // If Shion is currently hostile, update her physical actor ammo to match
        if and
            18@ == 1
            10@ > 0
        then
            017B: set_actor 10@ weapon 5@ ammo_to 6@
        end

        // Play Ammo Pooling Feedback
        0085: 30@ = 31@
        000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
        0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 3 virtual_protect 0
        018C: play_sound 1058 at 0.0 0.0 0.0
        03EB: clear_small_messages_only
        0ADF: add_text_label "Y_SWPL" text "~y~Jo'on: ~s~\"Catch! Keep firin' away!\"~n~~b~Shion: ~w~\"There goes our dinner in smoke...\""
        09C1: add_next_text_to_brief_history 1
        00BC: show_text_highpriority GXT 'Y_SWPL' time 3000 flag 1
        wait 2500
        0085: 30@ = 31@
        000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
        0A8D: 19@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
        if
            19@ == 3
        then
            0085: 30@ = 31@
            000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
            0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0
        end
        return
    end

    // Sub-case: Initial weapon handover to Shion
    // Strip weapon from Jo'on
    0555: remove_weapon 27@ from_actor 28@
    01B9: set_actor 28@ armed_weapon_to 0

    // Assign to Shion in RAM
    0085: 5@ = 27@
    0085: 6@ = 29@
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_WEAPON_ID
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 5@ virtual_protect 0

    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_AMMO_COUNT
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 6@ virtual_protect 0

    // Clear physical weapons on Shion
    048F: actor 10@ remove_weapons
    01B9: set_actor 10@ armed_weapon_to 0

    // Give weapon to Shion
    0781: get_weapon_with_ID 5@ model_to 12@
    if
        12@ > 0
    then
        0247: load_model 12@
        038B: load_requested_models

        :Wait_Shion_Give_Model
        wait 0
        if
            8256: not player $PLAYER_CHAR defined
        then
            0249: release_model 12@
            return
        end
        if
            856D: not actor 10@ defined
        then
            0249: release_model 12@
            return
        end
        if
            0118: actor 10@ dead
        then
            0249: release_model 12@
            return
        end
        if
            8248: not model 12@ available
        then
            goto @Wait_Shion_Give_Model
        end

        01B2: give_actor 10@ weapon 5@ ammo 6@
        01B9: set_actor 10@ armed_weapon_to 5@
        017B: set_actor 10@ weapon 5@ ammo_to 6@
        0249: release_model 12@
    end

    // Engage Hostile Stance
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_STANCE
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 1 virtual_protect 0
    gosub @Apply_Shion_Hostile_Mode

    // Play Handover Dialogue
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 3 virtual_protect 0
    018C: play_sound 1058 at 0.0 0.0 0.0
    03EB: clear_small_messages_only
    0ADF: add_text_label "Y_SWGV" text "~y~Jo'on: ~s~\"Hold this and cover me! And don't you dare drop it!\"~n~~b~Shion: ~w~\"Yeah yeah... I'll try not to miss.\""
    09C1: add_next_text_to_brief_history 1
    00BC: show_text_highpriority GXT 'Y_SWGV' time 3000 flag 1
    wait 2500
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
    0A8D: 19@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
    if
        19@ == 3
    then
        0085: 30@ = 31@
        000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
        0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0
    end
    return
end

// =========================================================================
// SUBROUTINE: NON-LINEAR MILESTONE EVALUATION MATRIX
// =========================================================================
:Evaluate_Nonlinear_Milestones
// Channel Guard: Subtitle channel must be completely open
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
0A8D: 28@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
if
    28@ > 0
then
    return
end

// Diner Guard: Must not be eating

    8039: not 28@ == 0
then
    return
end

// Controllability Guard

    83EE: not player $PLAYER_CHAR controllable
then
    return
end

// Proximity Guard (Within 6m on foot or near car, or together in same car)
27@ = 0
if
    00DF: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR driving
then
    03C0: 28@ = actor $PLAYER_ACTOR car
    if
        00DB: actor 10@ in_car 28@
    then
        27@ = 1
    else
        00A0: store_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR position_to 20@ 21@ 22@
        00A0: store_actor 10@ position_to 23@ 24@ 25@
        050A: 26@ = distance_between_XYZ 20@ 21@ 22@ and_XYZ 23@ 24@ 25@

            26@ <= 6.0
        then
            27@ = 1
        end
    end
else
    00A0: store_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR position_to 20@ 21@ 22@
    00A0: store_actor 10@ position_to 23@ 24@ 25@
    050A: 26@ = distance_between_XYZ 20@ 21@ 22@ and_XYZ 23@ 24@ 25@
    if
        26@ <= 6.0
    then
        27@ = 1
    end
end

if
    27@ == 0
then
    return
end

// Combat Guard
if or
    02E0: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR firing_weapon
    0E47: is_char_fighting $PLAYER_ACTOR
    02E0: actor 10@ firing_weapon
    0E47: is_char_fighting 10@
then
    return
end

// Health Floor Guard: Shion must be healthy
0226: 28@ = actor 10@ health
if
    28@ < 700
then
    return
end

// Hunger Guard: Shion must not be hungry (Bypassed if EnableFoodRuns is disabled)
0AF0: 25@ = read_int_from_ini_file "cleo\Shion.ini" section "FoodRun" key "EnableFoodRuns"
if
    25@ == 1
then
    0AF0: 24@ = read_int_from_ini_file "cleo\Shion.ini" section "FoodRun" key "HungerIntervalHours"
    if
        24@ <= 0
    then
        24@ = 48
    end

    0652: 28@ = integer_stat 134
    0012: 28@ *= 24
    00BF: 29@ = current_time_hours, 26@ = current_time_minutes
    005A: 28@ += 29@

    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_LAST_FED_HOURS
    0A8D: 29@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
    0062: 28@ -= 29@
    if
        002D: 28@ >= 24@
    then
        return
    end
end

            26@ = 1

    end

        29@ == 18
    then

            0EEA: locate_char_distance_to_coordinates $PLAYER_ACTOR pos -227.0280 1401.2290 27.7690 radius 35.0
        then
            26@ = 1
        end
    end

    if
        26@ == 1
    then
        if
            80DF: not actor $PLAYER_ACTOR driving
        then
            000A: 17@ += 250
            if
                17@ >= 4000
            then
                17@ = 0
                8@ = 12
                gosub @Prompt_Lore_Conversation
                return
            end
            return
        else
            17@ = 0
        end
    else
        17@ = 0
    end
end

==================================================

{$CLEO .c}
{$USE CLEO+}
{$USE memory}
{$USE ini}

0000: NOP
script_name "Sh_Menu"

// =========================================================================
// YORIGAMI MASTER HEAP DICTIONARY (PRUNED FOR SH_MENU)
// =========================================================================
const
    MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK = 20
    MEM_LORE_MENU_SIGNAL = 24
    MEM_DURGASTRA_FLAG = 72
    MEM_SHION_HANDLE = 116
    MEM_COMBAT_RES_MODE = 132
    MEM_CMBT_HITODAMA_FX = 156
    MEM_SAFEHOUSE_DOOR_ID = 340
end

// 0@ = Shion Actor Handle passed on boot
0085: 10@ = 0@

wait 1000

:Connect_To_Brain
wait 0
0AAA: 31@ = get_script_struct_named 'Y_Brain'
if
    31@ == 0 
then
    goto @Connect_To_Brain
end
000A: 31@ += 0x3C 
0A8D: 31@ = read_memory 31@ size 4 virtual_protect 0 
// 31@ NOW HOLDS THE MASTER POINTER.

0@ = 0   // Safehouse Visit Prompt Latch (0 = Ready to show, 1 = Shown for this visit)
1@ = -1  // Native Menu Panel Handle (-1 = closed)
8@ = 0   // TAB Hold Accumulator Timer (ms)
11@ = 0  // Active Menu Page: 0 = Overview & Arsenal, 1 = Lifestyle & Settings
14@ = -1 // Audio tick previous row tracker
15@ = 0  // Active Menu Row Index (0 to 7)
18@ = 0  // Inside Safehouse Boolean Flag (1 = Yes, 0 = No)

// Read initial config from Shion.ini into RAM
gosub @Reload_Menu_Settings

:ShionMenu_Loop
wait 50

if
    8256: not is_player_playing $PLAYER_CHAR
then
    goto @ShionMenu_Loop
end

// Read Live Handle from Shared Memory
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
0A8D: 10@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

if
    10@ == 0
then
    0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
end

if
    10@ > 0
then
    if or
        856D: not actor 10@ defined
        0118: actor 10@ dead
    then
        0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
    end
end

// Don't evaluate during screen fades or game cutscenes
if or
    016B: fading
    0E25: is_on_cutscene
then
    goto @ShionMenu_Loop
end

// =========================================================================
// SAFEHOUSE PROXIMITY & ENTRANCE LATCH MONITOR
// =========================================================================
gosub @Check_Inside_Safehouse

if
    18@ == 1 // Player is confirmed inside a Safehouse!
then
    // Only prompt if not currently in a vehicle, fully controllable, and channel is not Tier 4 locked
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
    0A8D: 26@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
    if and
        816B: not fading
        03EE: player $PLAYER_CHAR controllable
        80DF: not actor $PLAYER_ACTOR driving
        26@ < 4
    then
        // Show Style 5 prompt once upon entering this safehouse
        if
            0@ == 0
        then
            0@ = 1
            0ADF: add_text_label "Y_SHOM" text "~y~SAFEHOUSE~n~~w~HOLD [TAB] FOR SHION MENU"
            09C1: add_next_text_to_brief_history 1
            00BA: show_text_styled GXT 'Y_SHOM' time 3500 style 5
        end

        // Listen for holding TAB (Key 9 or Pad Key 4)
        if or
            0AB0: is_key_pressed 9 // TAB Key
            00E1: player 0 pressed_key 4
        then
            000A: 8@ += 50
            if
                8@ >= 800 // Held for 800ms
            then
                8@ = 0
                gosub @Open_Shion_Menu
            end
        else
            8@ = 0
        end
    else
        8@ = 0
    end
else
    // Reset entrance latch when player exits the safehouse!
    0@ = 0
    8@ = 0
end

goto @ShionMenu_Loop


// =========================================================================
// SUBROUTINE: OPEN & PROCESS SHION SAFEHOUSE MENU
// =========================================================================
:Open_Shion_Menu
// Lock player controls and claim Tier 4 Master Theater priority
01B4: set_player $PLAYER_CHAR can_move 0
0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_Zone"
0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_Mny"
0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_Idle"
0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_Snip"
0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_Int"
0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_Veh"
0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_Rad"
0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_Sub"
0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_Wthr"
0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name "Sh_Star"
03EB: clear_small_messages_only

0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 4 virtual_protect 0 // Master lock freezes background chatter!
018C: play_sound 1058 at 0.0 0.0 0.0

// Create Native Interactive Panel immediately on-screen
0ADF: add_text_label "SH_TIT" text "SHION SETTINGS"

08D4: 1@ = create_panel_with_title 'SH_TIT' position 29.0 145.0 width 310.0 columns 1 interactive 1 background 1 alignment 0

11@ = 0  // Start on Page 0 (Overview & Arsenal)
15@ = 0  // Start at Row 0
14@ = -1
gosub @Refresh_Shion_Menu_Text

:Shion_Menu_Interactive_Loop
wait 0

if or
    8256: not is_player_playing $PLAYER_CHAR
    016B: fading
then
    goto @Close_Shion_Menu
end

// Read highlighted row directly from native menu manager
08D7: 15@ = panel 1@ active_row

// Audio tick on row navigation
if
    803B: not 15@ == 14@
then
    0085: 14@ = 15@
end

// Display Current Page instruction subtitle
0085: 24@ = 11@
000A: 24@ += 1 // 1-based page index for display
0AD1: show_formatted_text_highpriority "~y~Shion Menu ~w~[Page %d/2] ~s~[Q/E: Page  |  SPACE: Select/Toggle  |  ENTER: Close]" time 100 24@

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// PAGINATION HOTKEYS: Q (Key 81 = Prev) & E (Key 69 = Next)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Next Page (E Key)
if
    0AB0: is_key_pressed 69 // E Key
then
    :Wait_Menu_E_Rel
    wait 50
    if
        0AB0: is_key_pressed 69
    then
        goto @Wait_Menu_E_Rel
    end

    if
        11@ == 0
    then
        11@ = 1
        15@ = 0
        018C: play_sound 1058 at 0.0 0.0 0.0
        gosub @Refresh_Shion_Menu_Text
    end

{$CLEO .c}
{$USE CLEO+}
{$USE memory}
{$USE ini}

0000: NOP

:Connect_To_Brain
wait 0
0AAA: 31@ = get_script_struct_named 'Y_Brain'
if
    31@ == 0 
then
    goto @Connect_To_Brain
end
000A: 31@ += 0x3C 
0A8D: 31@ = read_memory 31@ size 4 virtual_protect 0 
// 31@ NOW HOLDS THE MASTER POINTER.

script_name "Sh_Pimp"

// 0@ = Shion Actor Handle passed from SpawnShion.cs
0085: 10@ = 0@

1@ = 0 // Session Prompt Latch (0 = Not shown yet, 1 = Shown once this session)

// Load Configuration from Shion.ini
gosub @Load_Pimp_Config

:ShionPimp_Loop
wait 100

if or
    8256: not player $PLAYER_CHAR defined
    8019: not 10@ > 0
    856D: not actor 10@ defined
    0118: actor 10@ dead
then
    0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
end

// Only evaluate when driving, not on a mission, and not fading
if and
    00DF: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR driving
    0038: $ONMISSION == 0
    816B: not fading
    8E25: not is_on_cutscene
then
    03C0: 24@ = actor $PLAYER_ACTOR car
    if and
        056E: car 24@ defined
        8119: not car 24@ wrecked
    then
        // Shion must be in the vehicle with you
        if
            00DB: actor 10@ in_car 24@
        then
            0441: 25@ = car 24@ model

            // Filter Out Incompatible Vehicles
            26@ = 1 // 1 = Valid 4-Door Car

            // Exclude Broadway (Vanilla game handles Broadway natively)
            if
                25@ == 575
            then
                26@ = 0
            end

            // Exclude Taxis & Cabbie
            if or
                25@ == 420
                25@ == 438
            then
                26@ = 0
            end

            // Exclude Emergency & Service Vehicles (Batch 1)
            if or
                25@ == 416 // Ambulance
                25@ == 407 // Firetruck
                25@ == 544 // Firetruck LA
                25@ == 596 // Cop LA
                25@ == 597 // Cop SF
                25@ == 598 // Cop LV
                25@ == 599 // Cop Rural
                25@ == 427 // Enforcer
            then
                26@ = 0
            end

                                    then
                                        if

                                        then
                                            19@ = 1
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            if
                                0039: 19@ == 1
                            then
                                21@ = 2
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    // If valid strike/impact occurred, filter civilian innocence
    if
        0019: 21@ > 0
    then
        089F: get_actor 8@ pedtype_to 23@
        // Victim must be an ambient civilian (PedType 4 or 5)
        if or
            23@ == 4 // CivMale
            23@ == 5 // CivFemale
        then
            // Exclude script-controlled mission actors/targets
            if
                8E0A: not is_char_script_controlled 8@
            then
                // Exclude armed peds (holding any knife, bat, gun, etc.)
                0470: 22@ = actor 8@ current_weapon
                if
                    8019: not 22@ > 0 // Unarmed bare fists only
                then

                    if and
                        8E47: not is_char_fighting 8@
                        8E46: not is_char_using_gun 8@
                        82E0: not actor 8@ firing_weapon

                        if

                        then
                            24@ = 1
                        end

                        if
                            0039: 24@ == 0
                        then
                            if
                                0019: 10@ > 0
                            then
                                if
                                    056D: actor 10@ defined
                                then
                                    if
                                        051A: actor 10@ damaged_by_actor 8@
                                    then
                                        24@ = 1
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        if
                            24@ == 0
                        then
                            // Exclude peds actively targeting anyone to kill/attack
                            0E44: get_char_kill_target_char 8@ store_to 22@
                            if
                                8019: not 22@ > 0 // Must have NO active kill target
                            then
                                // Exclude corner drug dealers & street criminal skins
                                0665: get_actor 8@ model_to 22@
                                28@ = 0
                                if or
                                    22@ == 29  // BMYDRUG
                                    22@ == 30  // WMYDRUG
                                    22@ == 21  // BMYST
                                    22@ == 47  // BMYCR
                                then
                                    28@ = 1
                                end
                                if or
                                    22@ == 143 // WMYCR
                                    22@ == 144 // BMYCR
                                    22@ == 188 // WMYCR
                                    22@ == 230 // HMYCR
                                then
                                    28@ = 1
                                end
                                if or
                                    22@ == 253 // WMYCR
                                    22@ == 254 // BMYCR
                                    22@ == 255 // HMYCR
                                    22@ == 256 // BMYCR
                                then
                                    28@ = 1
                                end

                                if
                                    28@ == 0
                                then
                                    if

                                        then

                                        else

                            end

                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    // --- SHION ENTITY & INVENTORY DATA ---
    MEM_SHION_HANDLE = 116

    // --- SHIONMEMORIES.INI TELEMETRY (THE LEDGER) ---
    MEM_PIMPING_LEVEL = 240
    MEM_BURGLARIES = 264
    MEM_PARAMEDIC_SAVES = 280
    MEM_FIREFIGHT_EXTING = 260
    MEM_VIGILANTE_KILLS = 352
    MEM_TAXI_FARES = 356
end

:Connect_To_Brain
wait 0
0AAA: 31@ = get_script_struct_named 'Y_Brain'
if
    31@ == 0 
then
    goto @Connect_To_Brain
end
000A: 31@ += 0x3C 
0A8D: 31@ = read_memory 31@ size 4 virtual_protect 0 
// 31@ NOW HOLDS THE MASTER POINTER.

9@ = 0  // Burglary Fenced State Latch (0 = Ready, 1 = Latched)
14@ = 0 // Tracked Paramedic Patients Saved (Stat 151)
15@ = 0 // Tracked Pimping Mission Level (0xA48A24)
16@ = 0 // Tracked Fires Extinguished (Stat 153)
17@ = 0 // Tracked Vigilante Kills (Stat 152)
18@ = 0 // Tracked Taxi Fares (Stat 150)

// Initialize baselines from current savegame
0652: 14@ = integer_stat 151 // People saved in an Ambulance
0652: 16@ = integer_stat 153 // Total fires extinguished
0652: 17@ = integer_stat 152 // Criminals killed on Vigilante Mission
0652: 18@ = integer_stat 150 // Passengers dropped off

:ShionTrackMissions_Loop
wait 250

if
    8256: not player $PLAYER_CHAR defined
then
    goto @ShionTrackMissions_Loop
end

// Read Live Shion Handle from Shared Memory
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
0A8D: 10@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

// Bailout and sync baselines if Shion is dismissed (0) or dead in solid form
if
    10@ == 0
then
    9@ = 0
    15@ = 0
    0652: 14@ = integer_stat 151
    0652: 16@ = integer_stat 153
    0652: 17@ = integer_stat 152
    0652: 18@ = integer_stat 150
    goto @ShionTrackMissions_Loop
end

if
    10@ > 0
then
    if or
        856D: not actor 10@ defined
        0118: actor 10@ dead
    then
        9@ = 0
        15@ = 0
        0652: 14@ = integer_stat 151
        0652: 16@ = integer_stat 153
        0652: 17@ = integer_stat 152
        0652: 18@ = integer_stat 150
        goto @ShionTrackMissions_Loop
    end
end

// =========================================================================
// PIMPING WITH SHION TRACKER (Hitodama & Physical)
// Tracks successful client drop-offs during Pimping sub-mission with Shion
// =========================================================================
if and
    0038: $ONMISSION == 1
    0038: $162 == 1
then
    0A8D: 28@ = read_memory 0xA48A24 size 4 virtual_protect 0
    if
        001D: 28@ > 15@
    then
        0085: 15@ = 28@

        if
            0449: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR in_a_car
        then
            03C0: 27@ = actor $PLAYER_ACTOR car
            23@ = 0
            if
                10@ == -1
            then
                23@ = 1
            else
                if
                    00DB: actor 10@ in_car 27@
                then
                    23@ = 1
                end
            end

            if
                23@ == 1
            then
                0085: 30@ = 31@
                000A: 30@ += MEM_PIMPING_LEVEL
                0A8D: 25@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
                000A: 25@ += 1
                0085: 30@ = 31@
                000A: 30@ += MEM_PIMPING_LEVEL
                0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 25@ virtual_protect 0
            end
        end
    end
else
    15@ = 0
end

// =========================================================================
// BURGLARY FENCED WATCHDOG (Hitodama & Physical - Latched with 9@)
// Tracks successful lockup garage drop-offs during Burglary with Shion
// =========================================================================
if
    0038: $ONMISSION_BURGLARY == 1
then
    00A0: store_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR position_to 24@ 25@ 26@
    28@ = 0

    // LS Lockup (Playa del Seville)
    050A: 27@ = distance_between_XYZ 24@ 25@ 26@ and_XYZ 2738.0 -2013.0 13.0
    if
        8021: not 27@ > 10.0
    then
        28@ = 1
    end

    // SF Lockup (Doherty)
    050A: 27@ = distance_between_XYZ 24@ 25@ 26@ and_XYZ -2102.5 -15.7 35.3
    if
        8021: not 27@ > 10.0
    then
        28@ = 1
    end

    // LV Lockup (Pilgrim / Camel's Toe)
    050A: 27@ = distance_between_XYZ 24@ 25@ 26@ and_XYZ 2609.3 1437.9 10.8
    if
        8021: not 27@ > 10.0
    then
        28@ = 1
    end

    if
        28@ == 1
    then
        if
            9@ == 0
        then
            if
                00DF: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR driving
            then
                03C0: 27@ = actor $PLAYER_ACTOR car
                if
                    01C1: car 27@ stopped
                then
                    0441: 26@ = car 27@ model
                    if
                        26@ == 609 // Black Boxville
                    then
                        23@ = 0
                        if
                            10@ == -1
                        then
                            23@ = 1
                        else
                            if
                                00DB: actor 10@ in_car 27@
                            then
                                23@ = 1
                            end
                        end

                        if
                            23@ == 1
                        then
                            0085: 30@ = 31@
                            000A: 30@ += MEM_BURGLARIES
                            0A8D: 25@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
                            000A: 25@ += 1
                            0085: 30@ = 31@
                            000A: 30@ += MEM_BURGLARIES
                            0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 25@ virtual_protect 0
                            9@ = 1
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    else
        9@ = 0
    end
else
    9@ = 0
end

const
    MEM_SHION_BUSY = 4            // Protects Shion from follow watchdog during events
    MEM_SHION_HANDLE = 116        // Live entity handle or Hitodama state (-1)
    MEM_CASINO_LOSSES = 256       // Net casino losses telemetry
    MEM_CARS_WRECKED = 268        // Shared vehicle wrecks counter
    MEM_MOD_CASH_SPENT = 284      // Mod garage tuning expenditure
    MEM_LORE_PROGRESS_BIT = 244   // Lore completion bitmask
    MEM_LOWRIDER_DONE = 292       // Live lowrider dance completion trigger
    MEM_FAV_CAR_MODEL = 312       // Crowned favorite vehicle model ID
    MEM_FAV_CAR_MINUTES = 316     // Crowned favorite vehicle minutes
    MEM_CARS_MODDED = 320         // Vehicles modded with Shion count

16@ = 0 // Stationary Starting Wallet Snapshot
17@ = 0 // Mod Shop In-Shop Flag
18@ = 0 // Mod Shop Starting Cash
19@ = 0 // Last Driven Vehicle Handle

// =========================================================================
// CASINO LOSS TRACKER (Movement-Based Stationary Settlement)
// Tracks net gambling losses while Shion is present (Physical or Hitodama)
// =========================================================================
077E: get_active_interior_to 29@

28@ = 0

// Four Dragons Casino (Interior 10, Y > 900.0 excludes Safehouse 1 & Hashbury)
if and
    29@ == 10
    0021: 24@ > 1500.0
    0021: 25@ > 900.0
then
    28@ = 1
end

// Caligula's Casino (Interior 1, Y > 1500.0 excludes Sweet's House & Safehouse 4)
if and
    29@ == 1
    0021: 24@ > 1500.0
    0021: 25@ > 1500.0
then
    28@ = 1
end

// Inside Track Betting (Interior 3, exact coordinate radius excludes Johnson House)
if
    29@ == 3
then

        0EEA: locate_char_distance_to_coordinates $PLAYER_ACTOR pos 826.8863 5.5091 1004.4830 radius 40.0
    then
        28@ = 1
    end
end

if
    28@ == 1
then
    // In Hitodama Form (-1), Shion is floating right with Jo'on
    23@ = 0
    if
        10@ == -1
    then
        23@ = 1
    else
        if
            0EE4: locate_char_distance_to_char $PLAYER_ACTOR char 10@ radius 30.0
        then
            23@ = 1
        end
    end

    if
        23@ == 1
    then
        // Check if player is stationary on foot (seated at table, at machine, or standing still)
        if
            02A0: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR stopped
        then
            // Player just stopped / sat down to play
            if
                15@ == 0
            then
                15@ = 1 // Latch stationary state
                010B: 16@ = player $PLAYER_CHAR money // Snapshot wallet before any chips are placed
            end
        else
            // Player just started moving again / stood up from table
            if
                15@ == 1
            then
                15@ = 0 // Unlatch
                010B: 27@ = player $PLAYER_CHAR money // Read final wallet after game concludes

                if
                    001D: 16@ > 27@ // Net loss confirmed
                then
                    0085: 26@ = 16@
                    0062: 26@ -= 27@ // 26@ = True Net Loss

                    0085: 30@ = 31@
                    000A: 30@ += MEM_CASINO_LOSSES
                    0A8D: 25@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

                    005A: 25@ += 26@

                    0085: 30@ = 31@
                    000A: 30@ += MEM_CASINO_LOSSES
                    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 25@ virtual_protect 0
                end
                16@ = 0
            end
        end
    else
        // Shion drifted too far away: settle pending snapshot safely
        if
            15@ == 1
        then
            15@ = 0
            010B: 27@ = player $PLAYER_CHAR money
            if
                001D: 16@ > 27@
            then
                0085: 26@ = 16@
                0062: 26@ -= 27@

                0085: 30@ = 31@
                000A: 30@ += MEM_CASINO_LOSSES
                0A8D: 25@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

                005A: 25@ += 26@

                0085: 30@ = 31@
                000A: 30@ += MEM_CASINO_LOSSES
                0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 25@ virtual_protect 0
            end
            16@ = 0
        end
    end
else
    // Left the casino interior: settle pending snapshot safely
    if
        15@ == 1
    then
        15@ = 0
        010B: 27@ = player $PLAYER_CHAR money
        if
            001D: 16@ > 27@
        then
            0085: 26@ = 16@
            0062: 26@ -= 27@

            0085: 30@ = 31@
            000A: 30@ += MEM_CASINO_LOSSES
            0A8D: 25@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

            005A: 25@ += 26@

            0085: 30@ = 31@
            000A: 30@ += MEM_CASINO_LOSSES
            0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 25@ virtual_protect 0
        end
        16@ = 0
    end

        056E: car 27@ defined
    then
        // Latch that Jo'on and Shion are riding together inside this vehicle
        if
            00DB: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR in_car 27@
        then
            13@ = 1
        end

        8@ = 0 // 1 = Shion must disembark immediately

        // Emergency! Car caught on fire
        0227: 29@ = car 27@ health
        if
            29@ < 250
        then
            8@ = 1
        end

        // They were riding together, but Jo'on is now outside on foot
        if and
            8@ == 0
            13@ == 1
            80DB: not actor $PLAYER_ACTOR in_car 27@
        then
            8@ = 1
        end

        // They were riding together, and Jo'on just initiated vehicle exit
        if and
            8@ == 0
            13@ == 1
            0E4A: is_char_exiting_any_car $PLAYER_ACTOR
        then
            8@ = 1
        end

        // Jo'on entered or hijacked a different vehicle
        if and
            8@ == 0
            00DF: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR driving
        then
            03C0: 24@ = actor $PLAYER_ACTOR car
            if
                803B: not 27@ == 24@
            then
                8@ = 1
            end
        end

        // Execute Immediate Exit / Bailout
        if and
            8@ == 1
            14@ == 0
        then
            14@ = 1 // Lock command
            13@ = 0 // Clear riding latch

            // Measure true height above terrain using isolated float register 16@
            00AA: store_car 27@ position_to 20@ 21@ 22@
            02CE: 16@ = ground_z_at 20@ 21@ 22@
            0063: 22@ -= 16@

            // Check if vehicle is airborne and high up
            if and
                01F3: car 27@ in_air
                0021: 22@ > 12.0
            then
                // Aircraft Ejection into freefall
                0407: store_coords_to 20@ 21@ 22@ from_car 27@ with_offset 0.0 -2.5 -1.2
                0362: remove_actor 10@ from_car_and_place_at 20@ 21@ 22@
                083C: set_actor 10@ velocity_in_direction_XYZ 0.0 0.0 0.5
            else
                // Ground Vehicle Check
                02E3: 6@ = car 27@ speed
                if
                    0021: 6@ > 10.0 // Car rolling fast
                then
                    0622: AS_actor 10@ bail_car 27@
                else
                    0633: AS_actor 10@ exit_car
                end
            end
        end
    end
else
    // Shion is outside on foot: Reset latches
    14@ = 0
    13@ = 0
end

goto @ShionVehicle_Loop

// SUBROUTINE: SAFETY BAILOUT & WATCHDOG
// =========================================================================
:Check_Alive_Or_Exit
if or
    8256: not player $PLAYER_CHAR defined
    0E25: is_on_cutscene
    0EB7: is_on_scripted_cutscene
then
    0050: gosub @Release_Tier2_Lock_Safely
    0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
end

01F5: $PLAYER_ACTOR = get_player_actor $PLAYER_CHAR

// Abort if player dies, gets busted, enters water, or gets into a vehicle
if or
    0118: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR dead
    0741: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR busted
    04AD: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR in_water
    00DF: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR driving
then
    0050: gosub @Release_Tier2_Lock_Safely
    0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
end

// Abort if player answered a phone call
if
    0E42: is_char_doing_task_id $PLAYER_ACTOR 416
then
    0050: gosub @Release_Tier2_Lock_Safely
    0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
end

if or
    0611: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR performing_animation "phone_in"
    0611: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR performing_animation "phone_talk"
then
    0050: gosub @Release_Tier2_Lock_Safely
    0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
end

0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
0A8D: 2@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

if
    2@ == 0 // Inactive or dismissed
then
    0050: gosub @Release_Tier2_Lock_Safely
    0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
end

if
    2@ > 0 // Only check physical actor handle if in Solid Ped form
then
    if
        856D: not actor 2@ defined
    then
        0050: gosub @Release_Tier2_Lock_Safely
        0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
    end

    if or
        0118: actor 2@ dead
        04AD: actor 2@ in_water
    then
        0050: gosub @Release_Tier2_Lock_Safely
        0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
    end

    // Abort if separated by more than 35 meters on foot
    if
        8EE4: not locate_char_distance_to_char $PLAYER_ACTOR char 2@ radius 35.0
    then
        0050: gosub @Release_Tier2_Lock_Safely
        0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
    end
end
0051: return

// =========================================================================
// SUBROUTINE: SAFETY BAILOUT
// =========================================================================
:Check_Alive_Or_Exit
if or
    8256: not player $PLAYER_CHAR defined
    0E25: is_on_cutscene
    0EB7: is_on_scripted_cutscene
then
    03EB: clear_small_messages_only
    0050: gosub @Release_Tier2_Lock_Safely
    0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
end

01F5: $PLAYER_ACTOR = get_player_actor $PLAYER_CHAR
if or
    0118: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR dead
    0741: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR busted
then
    03EB: clear_small_messages_only
    0050: gosub @Release_Tier2_Lock_Safely
    0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
end

// Verify Shion handle and distance (stay within 30m)
if or
    8019: not 10@ > 0
    856D: not actor 10@ defined
then
    03EB: clear_small_messages_only
    0050: gosub @Release_Tier2_Lock_Safely
    0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
end

if or
    0118: actor 10@ dead
    8EE4: not locate_char_distance_to_char $PLAYER_ACTOR char 10@ radius 30.0
then
    03EB: clear_small_messages_only
    0050: gosub @Release_Tier2_Lock_Safely
    0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
end
0051: return

:Release_Tier2_Lock_Safely
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
0A8D: 19@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
if
    0039: 19@ == 2
then
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0
end
0051: return

:Finalize_Ambient_Chat
03EB: clear_small_messages_only
0050: gosub @Release_Tier2_Lock_Safely
0A93: terminate_this_custom_script

// =========================================================================
// SUBROUTINE: SAFETY BAILOUT
// =========================================================================
:Check_Alive_Or_Exit
if or
    8256: not player $PLAYER_CHAR defined
    0E25: is_on_cutscene
    0EB7: is_on_scripted_cutscene
then
    03EB: clear_small_messages_only
    0002: jump @Finalize_Ambient_Chat
end

01F5: $PLAYER_ACTOR = get_player_actor $PLAYER_CHAR

if or
    0118: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR dead
    0741: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR busted
then
    03EB: clear_small_messages_only
    0002: jump @Finalize_Ambient_Chat
end

0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
0A8D: 2@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

if
    2@ == 0
then
    03EB: clear_small_messages_only
    0002: jump @Finalize_Ambient_Chat
end

if
    2@ > 0
then
    if
        856D: not actor 2@ defined
    then
        03EB: clear_small_messages_only
        0002: jump @Finalize_Ambient_Chat
    end

    if
        0118: actor 2@ dead
    then
        03EB: clear_small_messages_only
        0002: jump @Finalize_Ambient_Chat
    end

    // Verify physical Shion is in the interior room within 35 meters
    if
        8EE4: not locate_char_distance_to_char $PLAYER_ACTOR char 2@ radius 35.0
    then
        03EB: clear_small_messages_only
        0002: jump @Finalize_Ambient_Chat
    end
end
0051: return

:Finalize_Ambient_Chat
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
0A8D: 19@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
if
    19@ == 2
then
    03EB: clear_small_messages_only
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0
end

// =========================================================================
// SUBROUTINE: SAFETY BAILOUT
// =========================================================================
:Check_Alive_Or_Exit
if or
    8256: not player $PLAYER_CHAR defined
    0E25: is_on_cutscene
    0EB7: is_on_scripted_cutscene
then
    0050: gosub @Release_Sub_Lock_Safely
    0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
end

01F5: $PLAYER_ACTOR = get_player_actor $PLAYER_CHAR
if or
    0118: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR dead
    0741: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR busted
then
    0050: gosub @Release_Sub_Lock_Safely
    0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
end

0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
0A8D: 18@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

if
    0039: 18@ == 0 // Inactive or dismissed
then
    0050: gosub @Release_Sub_Lock_Safely
    0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
end

if
    0019: 18@ > 0 // Only check actor handle if in Solid Ped form
then
    if or
        856D: not actor 18@ defined
        0118: actor 18@ dead
    then
        0050: gosub @Release_Sub_Lock_Safely
        0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
    end

    // If on foot outdoors, abort if separated by more than 35 meters
    if
        8449: not actor $PLAYER_ACTOR in_a_car
    then
        if
            8EE4: not locate_char_distance_to_char $PLAYER_ACTOR char 18@ radius 35.0
        then
            0050: gosub @Release_Sub_Lock_Safely
            0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
        end
    end
end
0051: return

:Release_Sub_Lock_Safely
03EB: clear_small_messages_only
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
0A8D: 19@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
if or
    0039: 19@ == 2
    0039: 19@ == 3
then
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0
end
0051: return

:Finalize_Ambient_Chat
0050: gosub @Release_Sub_Lock_Safely
0A93: terminate_this_custom_script



==================================================
FILE: .\Shion\Chat\chatVehicle.txt
==================================================
{$CLEO .c}
{$USE CLEO+}
{$USE memory}

0000: NOP
script_name "Sh_Veh"

// =========================================================================
// YORIGAMI MASTER HEAP DICTIONARY (PRUNED FOR SHIONVEHICLE)
// =========================================================================
const
    MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK = 20        // Priority lock latch
    MEM_SHION_HANDLE = 116        // Shion ped handle (-1 = Hitodama, >0 = Physical)
    MEM_SHION_PRES_HP = 160       // Hitodama presence HP / flame intensity
end

:Connect_To_Brain
wait 0 ms
0AAA: 31@ = get_script_struct_named 'Y_Brain'
if
    31@ == 0 
then
    goto @Connect_To_Brain
end
000A: 31@ += 0x3C 
0A8D: 31@ = read_memory 31@ size 4 virtual_protect 0 
if
    31@ == 0
then
    goto @Connect_To_Brain
end
// 31@ NOW HOLDS THE MASTER POINTER SAFELY.

// Check if Tier 3 (Action) or Tier 4 (Theater) is active
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
0A8D: 19@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
if
    04B5: 19@ >= 3
then
    0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
end

// Preempt lower-tier idle chatter scripts
0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name 'Sh_Zone'
0ABA: terminate_all_custom_scripts_with_this_name 'Sh_Idle'

// Claim Tier 2 Vehicle Lock
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 2 virtual_protect 0

// Validate Player Life & Driving State
if
    8256: not player $PLAYER_CHAR defined
then
    goto @Finalize_Ambient_Chat
end

01F5: $PLAYER_ACTOR = get_player_actor $PLAYER_CHAR
if or
    0118: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR dead
    0741: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR busted
    80DF: not actor $PLAYER_ACTOR driving
then
    goto @Finalize_Ambient_Chat
end

// 0@ = Shion Actor Handle passed from ShionChat.c
0085: 10@ = 0@

03C0: 24@ = actor $PLAYER_ACTOR car
0441: 25@ = car 24@ model

// Check Form Mode: 0 = Physical Ped, 1 = Hitodama Spirit
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
0A8D: 10@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
if
    10@ == -1
then
    11@ = 1 // Hitodama Form
else
    11@ = 0 // Physical Ped Form
end

gosub @Check_Alive_Or_Exit

// =========================================================================
// PHYSICAL FORM VEHICLE PRESENCE & DISTANCE GUARDS
// =========================================================================
if
    11@ == 0
then
    if
        10@ > 0
    then
        if
            056D: actor 10@ defined
        then
            // Bicycles have 1 seat: Shion must be sprinting nearby on foot
            if or
                25@ == 481
                25@ == 509
                25@ == 510
            then
                if
                    8EE4: not locate_char_distance_to_char $PLAYER_ACTOR char 10@ radius 30.0
                then
                    goto @Finalize_Ambient_Chat
                end
            else
                // All other vehicles (Motorcycles, Cars, Aircraft, Boats): Must be passenger!
                if
                    80DB: not actor 10@ in_car 24@
                then
                    goto @Finalize_Ambient_Chat
                end
            end
        else
            goto @Finalize_Ambient_Chat
        end
    end
end

// =========================================================================
// ROUTE 2-WHEELERS DIRECTLY TO THEIR DEDICATED POOLS
// =========================================================================

// BICYCLES (BMX 481, Bike 509, Mountain Bike 510)
if or
    25@ == 481
    25@ == 509
    25@ == 510
then
    goto @Bicycle_Cruising_Pool
end

// MOTORCYCLES (Split into Batches <= 8 Conditions)
26@ = 0
if
    047A: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR driving_bike
then
    26@ = 1
end

// Motorcycle Batch 1 (8 models)
if or
    25@ == 523 // HPV-1000 Police Bike
    25@ == 462 // Faggio
    25@ == 448 // Pizzaboy
    25@ == 581 // BF-400
    25@ == 586 // Wayfarer
    25@ == 521 // FCR-900
    25@ == 522 // NRG-500
    25@ == 461 // PCJ-600
then
    26@ = 1
end

// Motorcycle Batch 2 (2 models)
if or
    25@ == 463 // Freeway
    25@ == 468 // Sanchez
then
    26@ = 1
end

if
    26@ == 1
then
    if
        25@ == 523
    then
        goto @Police_Bike_Special
    end
    goto @Motorcycle_Cruising_Pool
end

// CENTRAL EXIT ROUTE & LOCK RELEASE
// =========================================================================
:Finalize_Wanted

if
    16@ == 3
then
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0 // Release Priority Lock
end
0A93: terminate_this_custom_script

// =========================================================================
// SUBROUTINE: SAFETY BAILOUT
// =========================================================================
:Check_Alive_Or_Exit
if or
    8256: not player $PLAYER_CHAR defined
    0E25: is_on_cutscene
    0EB7: is_on_scripted_cutscene
then
    0002: jump @Finalize_Wanted
end

if or
    0118: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR dead
    0741: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR busted
then
    0002: jump @Finalize_Wanted
end

// Check if another Tier 3 (Stance/Warp) or Tier 4 (Sister Talk) took over the mic while we slept!
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
0A8D: 16@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
if
    8039: not 16@ == 3
then
    // We lost ownership of the mic while sleeping; exit immediately without clearing prints!
    0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
end

0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
0A8D: 2@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

if
    2@ == 0 // Inactive or dismissed
then
    0002: jump @Finalize_Wanted
end

if
    2@ > 0 // Only check actor handle if in Solid Ped form!
then
    if or
        856D: not actor 2@ defined
        0118: actor 2@ dead
    then
        0002: jump @Finalize_Wanted
    end

    // If on foot, abort if separated by more than 35 meters
    if
        13@ == 1
    then
        if
            8EE4: not locate_char_distance_to_char $PLAYER_ACTOR char 2@ radius 35.0
        then
            0002: jump @Finalize_Wanted
        end
    else
        // In vehicle: physical Shion must still be in the car!
        if
            00DF: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR driving
        then
            03C0: 3@ = actor $PLAYER_ACTOR car
            if
                80DB: not actor 2@ in_car 3@
            then
                0002: jump @Finalize_Wanted
            end
        end
    end
end
return

0A8D: 19@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

    8039: not 19@ == 2
then
    0A93: terminate_this_custom_script
end

0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
0A8D: 2@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

if
    2@ == 0 // Inactive or dismissed
then
    03EB: clear_small_messages_only
    0002: jump @Finalize_Ambient_Chat
end

if
    2@ > 0 // Only check actor handle if in Solid Ped form
then
    if or
        856D: not actor 2@ defined
        0118: actor 2@ dead
    then
        03EB: clear_small_messages_only
        0002: jump @Finalize_Ambient_Chat
    end

    // If on foot, abort if separated by more than 35 meters
    if
        26@ == 0
    then
        if
            8EE4: not locate_char_distance_to_char $PLAYER_ACTOR char 2@ radius 35.0
        then
            03EB: clear_small_messages_only
            0002: jump @Finalize_Ambient_Chat
        end
    end
end
return

:Finalize_Ambient_Chat
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
0A8D: 19@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
if
    19@ == 2 // Only wipe prints and release if we still own the channel
then
    03EB: clear_small_messages_only
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0
end
0A93: terminate_this_custom_script

    return

    return
end

then
    20@ = 50
    return
end

    20@ = 100
    return
end
20@ = 10
return

// =========================================================================

    31@ == 0
then

0@ = -1  // Native Menu Panel Handle (-1 = closed)

4@ = 0   // Debug Unlock All Flag (0 = Normal Unlocked Only, 1 = Force Unlock All)

        80DF: not actor $PLAYER_ACTOR driving

        8E25: not is_on_cutscene
    then
        // Check if Shion is in play and alive
        0085: 30@ = 31@
        000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
        0A8D: 3@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

        12@ = 0
        if
            3@ > 0
        then
            if
                056D: actor 3@ defined
            then
                if
                    8118: not actor 3@ dead
                then
                    12@ = 1
                end
            end
        end

        if
            12@ == 0

            018C: play_sound 1057 at 0.0 0.0 0.0

        000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
        0A8D: 16@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

        0AD1: show_formatted_text_highpriority "~r~Must be on foot to open Sister Talk archive!" time 2000
        goto @LoreMenu_Idle_Loop
    end

goto @LoreMenu_Idle_Loop

            803B: not 29@ == 2@
            8039: not 25@ == 299

            07AF: 23@ = player $PLAYER_CHAR group
            07F6: get_group 23@ number_of_leaders_to 7@ number_of_members_to 6@
            if
                6@ > 0
            then
                for 7@ = 0 to 6
                    092B: 8@ = group 23@ member 7@
                    if
                        003B: 29@ == 8@
                    then
                        return
                    end
                end
            end

            // Exclude Special Actors ONLY during missions (Slots 1 to 10: Models 290..299)
            if
                0E1D: is_on_mission
            then
                if and
                    25@ >= 290
                    299 >= 25@
                then
                    return
                end
            end

            if
                8449: not actor 29@ in_a_car // Strictly On Foot (No passenger glitches!)
            then
                // Determine if target should retaliate with bare fists upon standing up
                8@ = 0

                // Check if ped was actively targeting player before blast

                    003B: 24@ == $PLAYER_ACTOR

                        24@ >= 7
                        14 >= 24@

                        then
                            8@ = 1
                        end
                    end

                06C9: remove_actor 29@ from_group

                // Kill all weapons, tasks, and forward momentum
                048F: actor 29@ remove_weapons
                0687: clear_actor 29@ task
                0E96: clear_char_primary_tasks 29@
                0E97: clear_char_secondary_tasks 29@
                083C: set_actor 29@ velocity_in_direction_XYZ 0.0 0.0 0.0

                // Prevent Recursive Callback Loop via Master Heap Lock
                0085: 30@ = 31@
                000A: 30@ += MEM_DMG_RECURSION_LCK
                0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 1 virtual_protect 0

                0851: set_actor 29@ decrease_health_by 5 affect_armour 0

                0085: 30@ = 31@
                000A: 30@ += MEM_DMG_RECURSION_LCK
                0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0
                
                // Spawn Single Blue Hitodama Curse Flame above victim's head!
                0A92: create_custom_thread "Yorigami\FX_HexFlame.c" 29@ 3200

                // Force immediate bone-level animation snap to override gang walk style
                0605: actor 29@ perform_animation "KO_SKID_BACK" IFP "PED" framedelta 8.0 loop 0 lockX 1 lockY 1 lockF 1 time 1500

                // Queue Task Sequence: Skid -> Get Up -> Bare-fisted Retaliation if Hostile

                0812: AS_actor -1 perform_animation "KO_SKID_BACK" IFP "PED" framedelta 8.0 loopA 0 lockX 1 lockY 1 lockF 1 time 1500
                0812: AS_actor -1 perform_animation "GETUP" IFP "PED" framedelta 4.0 loopA 0 lockX 1 lockY 1 lockF 0 time -1

                    8@ == 1

                    05E2: AS_actor -1 kill_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR
                end
                0616: define_AS_pack_end 23@
                0618: assign_actor 29@ to_AS_pack 23@
                061B: remove_references_to_AS_pack 23@
            end

                25@ > 0
            then

                    092B: 27@ = group 4@ member 26@
                    if
                        003B: 29@ == 27@
                    then
                        return
                    end
                end
            end

            // Exclude Special Actors ONLY during missions (Slots 1 to 10: Models 290..299)
            if
                0E1D: is_on_mission
            then
                if and
                    5@ >= 290
                    299 >= 5@
                then
                    return
                end
            end

            if
                8449: not actor 29@ in_a_car // Strictly On Foot (No passenger glitches!)
            then
                // Determine if target should retaliate with bare fists upon standing up
                24@ = 0

                // Check if ped was actively targeting player before blast
                0E44: get_char_kill_target_char 29@ store_to 23@
                if
                    003B: 23@ == $PLAYER_ACTOR
                then
                    24@ = 1
                end

                // Check if target is an enemy gang member during a live Gang War
                if
                    087A: gang_war_in_progress
                then
                    089F: get_actor 29@ pedtype_to 23@
                    if and
                        23@ >= 7
                        14 >= 23@
                    then
                        if
                            8039: not 23@ == 8 // Exclude Grove Street
                        then
                            24@ = 1
                        end
                    end
                end

                06C9: remove_actor 29@ from_group

                // Kill all weapons, tasks, and forward momentum
                048F: actor 29@ remove_weapons
                0687: clear_actor 29@ task
                0E96: clear_char_primary_tasks 29@
                0E97: clear_char_secondary_tasks 29@
                083C: set_actor 29@ velocity_in_direction_XYZ 0.0 0.0 0.0

                0851: set_actor 29@ decrease_health_by 5 affect_armour 0

                // Force immediate bone-level animation snap to override gang walk style
                0605: actor 29@ perform_animation "KO_SKID_BACK" IFP "PED" framedelta 8.0 loop 0 lockX 1 lockY 1 lockF 1 time 1500

                // Queue Task Sequence: Skid -> Get Up -> Bare-fisted Retaliation if Hostile
                0615: define_AS_pack_begin 2@
                0812: AS_actor -1 perform_animation "KO_SKID_BACK" IFP "PED" framedelta 8.0 loopA 0 lockX 1 lockY 1 lockF 1 time 1500
                0812: AS_actor -1 perform_animation "GETUP" IFP "PED" framedelta 4.0 loopA 0 lockX 1 lockY 1 lockF 0 time -1

                    24@ == 1

                0616: define_AS_pack_end 2@

                061B: remove_references_to_AS_pack 2@

    19@ == 1

                gosub @Trigger_Grim_Pity
            end
        end

                02E1: 0@ = create_cash_pickup 18@ at 23@ 24@ 25@ permanence_flag 0

                // Award Respect
                0653: 27@ = float_stat 64
                0093: 28@ = integer 9@ to_float
                005B: 27@ += 28@
                if
                    0021: 27@ > 1000.0
                then
                    27@ = 1000.0
                end
                062A: change_float_stat 64 to 27@

                018C: play_sound 1058 at 0.0 0.0 0.0
                036D: show_text_2numbers_styled GXT 'Y_MEXT' numbers 18@ 9@ time 3000 style 5

                // Clean up Marker & Particle
                if
                    0019: 11@ > 0
                then
                    0164: disable_marker 11@
                    11@ = 0
                end
                if
                    0019: 12@ > 0
                then
                    064E: stop_particle 12@
                    0650: destroy_particle 12@
                    064F: remove_references_to_particle 12@
                    12@ = 0
                end

                10@ = 0
                0085: 30@ = 31@
                000A: 30@ += MEM_ACTIVE_MARK
                0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0
                TIMERA = 0
                0209: 14@ = random_int_in_ranges 4@ 5@
                goto @YMark_Loop
            end
        end

        // CASE B: MARK WAS KILLED!
        if
            0118: actor 10@ dead
        then
            gosub @Calculate_Jackpot_Cash

            // Grab ground coordinates of the corpse
            04A5: get_dead_actor_pickup_coords 10@ store_to 23@ 24@ 25@

            // Drop Jackpot Cash on corpse
            02E1: 0@ = create_cash_pickup 18@ at 23@ 24@ 25@ permanence_flag 0

            018C: play_sound 1058 at 0.0 0.0 0.0
            01E3: show_text_1number_styled GXT 'Y_MKILL' number 18@ time 3000 style 5

            gosub @Cleanup_Mark
            goto @YMark_Loop
        end

        // CASE C: MARK ESCAPED (Timed out or player moved > 150m away)
        0085: 15@ = TIMERB
        if or
            002D: 15@ >= 13@
            0021: 26@ > 150.0
        then
            gosub @Cleanup_Mark
            00BA: show_text_styled GXT 'Y_MESC' time 2500 style 5
            goto @YMark_Loop
        end
    else
        // Mark despawned unexpectedly
        gosub @Cleanup_Mark
        goto @YMark_Loop
    end
end

// =========================================================================
// SUBROUTINE: EXECUTE YORIGAMI CONTRACT (Predatory Loan)
// =========================================================================
:Menu_Execute_Contract
010B: 20@ = player $PLAYER_CHAR money

// Read Minimum Cash Required to qualify (Default: $0)
0AF0: 21@ = read_int_from_ini_file "cleo\YorigamiPerks.ini" section "Contract" key "MinCashRequiredToSign"
if
    001B: 0 > 21@
then
    21@ = 0
end

// Check if player is eligible (Must NOT be in debt!)
if
    001D: 21@ > 20@
then
    // REJECTED: Player is already in debt!
    018C: play_sound 1057 at 0.0 0.0 0.0
    03EB: clear_small_messages_only
    0ACE: print_help_formatted "~r~Contract Rejected! You must pay off your existing debt first!"
else
    // ACCEPTED: The Shark Deal is sealed!
    0AF0: 22@ = read_int_from_ini_file "cleo\YorigamiPerks.ini" section "Contract" key "ContractPoints"
    if
        002B: 0 >= 22@
    then
        22@ = 100
    end

    0AF0: 23@ = read_int_from_ini_file "cleo\YorigamiPerks.ini" section "Settings" key "CashPerPoint"
    if
        002B: 0 >= 23@
    then
        23@ = 10000
    end

    // Calculate Total Debt: ContractPoints * CashPerPoint (006A)
    0085: 24@ = 22@
    006A: 24@ *= 23@ // 24@ = Total Debt (e.g. $1,000,000)

    // Inform yorigami.txt Escrow of the contract debt to prevent double-dipping!
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_CONTRACT_ESCROW
    0A8D: 26@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
    if
        001B: 0 > 26@
    then
        26@ = 0
    end
    005A: 26@ += 24@
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_CONTRACT_ESCROW
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 26@ virtual_protect 0

    // Negate to deduct cash
    0085: 25@ = 24@
    0012: 25@ *= -1
    0109: player $PLAYER_CHAR money += 25@

    // CREDIT Y-POINTS TO LIFETIME TOTAL & AVAILABLE POOL!
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_TOTAL_POINTS
    0A8D: 26@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
    005A: 26@ += 22@
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_TOTAL_POINTS
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 26@ virtual_protect 0

    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_AVAIL_POINTS
    0A8D: 26@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
    005A: 26@ += 22@
    0085: 30@ = 31@
    000A: 30@ += MEM_AVAIL_POINTS
    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 26@ virtual_protect 0

    // Sensory & Audio
    0AF0: 26@ = read_int_from_ini_file "cleo\YorigamiPerks.ini" section "Contract" key "PlayContractSound"
    if
        0039: 26@ == 1
    then
        018C: play_sound 1147 at 0.0 0.0 0.0
    end

    0AF0: 26@ = read_int_from_ini_file "cleo\YorigamiPerks.ini" section "Contract" key "ShowContractMessage"
    if
        0039: 26@ == 1
    then
        03EB: clear_small_messages_only
        0ACE: print_help_formatted "~r~YORIGAMI CONTRACT SIGNED! ~w~+$%d Debt Taken | +%d Y-Points!" 24@ 22@
    end
end
return
