// =========================================================================
// DAMAGE CALLBACK (0EDE: Intercept Incoming Hits & Reflect Pain!)
// =========================================================================
:OnCharDamage
// Safety guards to prevent null-pointer crashes if player state is invalid
if
    8256: not player $PLAYER_CHAR defined
then
    0ED0: return_script_event
end

01F5: 15@ = get_player_actor $PLAYER_CHAR
if
    856D: not actor 15@ defined
then
    0ED0: return_script_event
end

// Check and prevent recursion loops triggered by 0851 damage (Uses dedicated 25@)
0085: 25@ = 31@
000A: 25@ += MEM_DMG_RECURSION_LCK
0A8D: 13@ = read_memory 25@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
if
    13@ == 1
then
    0ED0: return_script_event
end

if and
    0019: 2@ > 0  // Alloc_MiseryLovesCompany > 0
    056D: actor 19@ defined
    8118: not actor 19@ dead
then
    // Verify CJ was the victim
    if
        003B: 19@ == 15@
    then
        0EB5: get_char_damage_last_frame 19@ damager 26@ type 27@ part 28@ intensity 29@

        // Early cutoff for zero-damage taps
        if
            0021: 29@ > 0.0
        then
            010B: 18@ = player $PLAYER_CHAR money
            // Requires being broke or in debt!
            if
                18@ <= 0
            then
                // Must have a valid attacker pointer (ignores fall/drown damage)
                if
                    8039: not 26@ == 0
                then
                    17@ = 0
                    0E13: get_entity 26@ type_to 16@

                    // Direct Ped Attacker
                    if
                        16@ == 3 // ENTITY_TYPE_PED
                    then
                        0AEA: 17@ = ped_struct 26@ handle
                    end

                    // Vehicular / Drive-by Attacker
                    if
                        16@ == 2 // ENTITY_TYPE_VEHICLE
                    then
                        0AEB: 12@ = vehicle_struct 26@ handle
                        if
                            056E: car 12@ defined
                        then
                            046C: 17@ = car 12@ driver
                        end
                    end

                    if
                        17@ > 0
                    then
                        if and
                            056D: actor 17@ defined
                            803B: not 17@ == 15@ // Attacker is not CJ
                        then
                            // Check that attacker is not Shion
                            0085: 25@ = 31@
                            000A: 25@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
                            0A8D: 13@ = read_memory 25@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
                            if
                                803B: not 17@ == 13@
                            then
                                if
                                    8118: not actor 17@ dead
                                then
                                    // Engage recursion lock
                                    0085: 25@ = 31@
                                    000A: 25@ += MEM_DMG_RECURSION_LCK
                                    0A8C: write_memory 25@ size 4 value 1 virtual_protect 0

                                    // Store coordinates while attacker is guaranteed alive
                                    04C4: store_coords_to 20@ 21@ 22@ from_actor 17@ with_offset 0.0 0.0 0.2

                                    // Calculate Reflection %: Base + (Points * PerPoint)
                                    0085: 10@ = 2@
                                    006A: 10@ *= 5@ // Points * ReflectionPerPoint (006A)
                                    005A: 10@ += 4@ // Base + Bonus (005A)

                                    // Clamp to MaxReflectionCap
                                    if
                                        001D: 10@ > 6@
                                    then
                                        0085: 10@ = 6@
                                    end

                                    // Convert to Float Multiplier: 10@ / 100.0
                                    0093: 11@ = integer 10@ to_float
                                    0017: 11@ /= 100.0

                                    // Calculate Reflected Damage = Intensity(float) * Multiplier
                                    006B: 29@ *= 11@
                                    0092: 23@ = float 29@ to_integer

                                    // Ensure at least 1 damage is reflected on light hits
                                    if
                                        23@ <= 0
                                    then
                                        23@ = 1
                                    end

                                    // Apply Script Damage to Actor Handle 17@
                                    0851: set_actor 17@ decrease_health_by 23@ affect_armour 1

                                    // Audio: Dark pain sound on attacker coordinates
                                    if
                                        7@ == 1
                                    then
                                        018C: play_sound 1057 at 20@ 21@ 22@
                                    end

                                    // Visual: shion_misfortune from attacker
                                    if
                                        8@ == 1
                                    then
                                        064B: 14@ = create_particle "shion_misfortune" at 20@ 21@ 22@ type 1
                                        064C: make_particle 14@ visible
                                        064F: remove_references_to_particle 14@
                                    end

                                    // Release recursion lock
                                    0085: 25@ = 31@
                                    000A: 25@ += MEM_DMG_RECURSION_LCK
                                    0A8C: write_memory 25@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
0ED0: return_script_event

                                        0AF0: 18@ = read_int_from_ini_file "cleo\YorigamiPerks.ini" section "ScavengerFeast" key "ShotgunAmmoMax"
                                        if
                                            18@ == 0
                                        then
                                            18@ = 12
                                        end

                                        0008: 18@ += 1
                                        0209: 16@ = random_int_in_ranges 17@ 18@
                                        if
                                            15@ == 1
                                        then
                                            0AD1: print_formatted_now "~w~Found a dented chrome shotgun with %d loose shells!~n~~g~[Y] Take  ~w~|  ~r~[N] Leave" 6000 16@
                                        else
                                            0AD1: print_formatted_now "~w~Found a rusty sawn-off shotgun with %d shells!~n~~g~[Y] Take  ~w~|  ~r~[N] Leave" 6000 16@
                                        end
                                    end

                                    // Melee Tools (Shovel 6, Bat 5, Knife 4)
                                    if
                                        27@ == 4
                                    then
                                        0209: 23@ = random_int_in_ranges 0 3
                                        if
                                            23@ == 0
                                        then
                                            0AD1: print_formatted_now "~w~Found a rusty garden shovel buried in the trash!~n~~g~[Y] Take  ~w~|  ~r~[N] Leave" 6000
                                        end
                                        if
                                            23@ == 1
                                        then
                                            0AD1: print_formatted_now "~w~Found a cracked baseball bat behind the dumpster!~n~~g~[Y] Take  ~w~|  ~r~[N] Leave" 6000
                                        end
                                        if
                                            23@ == 2
                                        then
                                            0AD1: print_formatted_now "~w~Found an old kitchen knife with tape on the handle!~n~~g~[Y] Take  ~w~|  ~r~[N] Leave" 6000
                                        end
                                    end

                                    // Wait for player decision ([Y] / [N] / 6s timeout)
                                    0085: 30@ = 31@
                                    000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
                                    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 3 virtual_protect 0 // Hold Tier 3 while deciding
                                    TIMERA = 0
                                    :Wait_Player_Scav_Decision
                                    wait 50

                                    // Priority lock release on death, bust, or despawn
                                    if or
                                        8256: not player $PLAYER_CHAR defined
                                        0117: player $PLAYER_CHAR wasted
                                        0741: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR busted
                                    then
                                        0085: 30@ = 31@
                                        000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
                                        0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0
                                        goto @YScav_Loop
                                    end

                                    // Option Y: Accept and equip
                                    if
                                        0AB0: is_key_pressed 89 // Y Key
                                    then
                                        :Wait_Player_Y_Rel
                                        wait 50
                                        if
                                            0AB0: is_key_pressed 89
                                        then
                                            goto @Wait_Player_Y_Rel
                                        end

                                        gosub @Give_Scavenged_Weapon_To_Player
                                        goto @Finish_Player_Scav_Weapon
                                    end

                                    // Option N: Refuse and leave
                                    if
                                        0AB0: is_key_pressed 78 // N Key
                                    then
                                        :Wait_Player_N_Rel
                                        wait 50
                                        if
                                            0AB0: is_key_pressed 78
                                        then
                                            goto @Wait_Player_N_Rel
                                        end

                                        26@ = 0 // Mark outcome as refused
                                        018C: play_sound 1057 at 0.0 0.0 0.0
                                        03EB: clear_small_messages_only
                                        0ACD: print_string_now "~s~Decided to leave the weapon in the garbage." 2500
                                        goto @Finish_Player_Scav_Weapon
                                    end

                                    // Timeout (6 seconds passed)
                                    if
                                        TIMERA >= 6000
                                    then
                                        26@ = 0 // Mark outcome as expired/refused
                                        03EB: clear_small_messages_only
                                        0ACD: print_string_now "~s~Left the weapon behind in the trash." 2000
                                        goto @Finish_Player_Scav_Weapon
                                    end

                                    goto @Wait_Player_Scav_Decision

                                    :Finish_Player_Scav_Weapon
                                    wait 1000
                                    0085: 30@ = 31@
                                    000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
                                    0A8D: 25@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
                                    if
                                        25@ == 3
                                    then
                                        0085: 30@ = 31@
                                        000A: 30@ += MEM_PRIORITY_LOCK
                                        0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 0 virtual_protect 0
                                    end
                                else
                                    // ---------------------------------------------
                                    // LOOT PATH B: FOOD & NUTRITION (Instant Heal)
                                    // ---------------------------------------------
                                    04ED: load_animation "FOOD"
                                    :Wait_Trash_Eat_Anim
                                    wait 0
                                    if
                                        84EE: not animation "FOOD" loaded
                                    then
                                        goto @Wait_Trash_Eat_Anim
                                    end

                                    0605: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR perform_animation "EAT_Burger" IFP "FOOD" framedelta 4.0 loop 0 lockX 1 lockY 1 lockF 0 time 2500
                                    wait 2500
                                    04EF: release_animation "FOOD"

                                    0223: set_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR health_to 176
                                    0A8C: write_memory 0xB7CEDC size 2 value 0 virtual_protect 0
                                    018C: play_sound 1052 at 0.0 0.0 0.0

                                    0209: 27@ = random_int_in_ranges 0 4

                                    if
                                        15@ == 1
                                    then
                                        if
                                            27@ == 0
                                        then
                                            0ACD: print_string_now "~g~Found a cold slice of Well Stacked Pizza! Score!" 3000
                                        end
                                        if
                                            27@ == 1
                                        then
                                            0ACD: print_string_now "~g~Found half an intact Burger Shot Double D-Luxe!" 3000
                                        end
                                        if
                                            27@ == 2
                                        then
                                            0ACD: print_string_now "~g~Found a discarded sub sandwich! Still wrapped in paper!" 3000
                                        end
                                        if
                                            27@ == 3
                                        then
                                            0ACD: print_string_now "~g~Found discarded fries and sweet sauce! Delicious." 3000
                                        end
                                    end

                                    if
                                        15@ == 2
                                    then
                                        if
                                            27@ == 0
                                        then
                                            0ACD: print_string_now "~g~Found a half-eaten glazed donut in a napkin!" 3000
                                        end
                                        if
                                            27@ == 1
                                        then
                                            0ACD: print_string_now "~g~Found an apple with only two bites taken out!" 3000
                                        end
                                        if
                                            27@ == 2
                                        then
                                            0ACD: print_string_now "~g~Found a squished hot dog bun with mustard! Still good." 3000
                                        end
                                        if
                                            27@ == 3
                                        then
                                            0ACD: print_string_now "~g~Found a cold fried chicken wing! Blessings from above." 3000
                                        end
                                    end

                                    if
                                        15@ == 3
                                    then
                                        if
                                            27@ == 0
                                        then
                                            0ACD: print_string_now "~g~Pulled a box of Cluckin' Little Meal nuggets from the tray bin!" 3000
                                        end
                                        if

                                        then

                                        end

                                        if
                                            27@ == 3
                                        then

                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            wait 1500
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

goto @YScav_Loop

// =========================================================================
// SUBROUTINE: RELOAD BINS CACHE (Loads INI Into RAM on Interior Change/Boot)
// =========================================================================
:Reload_Bins_Cache
// Cache VendorMemorySeconds (stored safely in 3@)
0AF0: 3@ = read_int_from_ini_file "cleo\YorigamiPerks.ini" section "ScavengerFeast" key "VendorMemorySeconds"
if
    3@ == 0
then
    3@ = 45
end
0012: 3@ *= 1000 // Convert to ms

// Read Bin Count for this interior (stored safely in 2@)
0AD3: string_format 4@v "Interior_%d" 0@
0AF0: 2@ = read_int_from_ini_file "cleo\savedata\YorigamiBins.ini" section 4@v key "Count"
if or
    8029: not 2@ >= 0
    2@ > 1000
then
    2@ = 0
end

if
    2@ > 0
then
    12@ = 1
    :Cache_Read_Loop
    if
        801D: not 12@ > 2@
    then
        // Destination Pointer = (12@ - 1) * 16 + 1@
        0085: 13@ = 12@
        000E: 13@ -= 1
        0012: 13@ *= 16
        005A: 13@ += 1@ // 13@ = Pointer in RAM

        // Read X from INI -> Write to RAM
        0AD3: string_format 8@v "Bin_%d_X" 12@
        0AF2: 16@ = read_float_from_ini_file "cleo\savedata\YorigamiBins.ini" section 4@v key 8@v
        0A8C: write_memory 13@ size 4 value 16@ virtual_protect 0

        // Read Y from INI -> Write to RAM
        000A: 13@ += 4
        0AD3: string_format 8@v "Bin_%d_Y" 12@
        0AF2: 16@ = read_float_from_ini_file "cleo\savedata\YorigamiBins.ini" section 4@v key 8@v
        0A8C: write_memory 13@ size 4 value 16@ virtual_protect 0

        // Read Z from INI -> Write to RAM
        000A: 13@ += 4
        0AD3: string_format 8@v "Bin_%d_Z" 12@
        0AF2: 16@ = read_float_from_ini_file "cleo\savedata\YorigamiBins.ini" section 4@v key 8@v
        0A8C: write_memory 13@ size 4 value 16@ virtual_protect 0

        // Read Tier from INI -> Write to RAM
        000A: 13@ += 4
        0AD3: string_format 8@v "Bin_%d_Tier" 12@
        0AF0: 16@ = read_int_from_ini_file "cleo\savedata\YorigamiBins.ini" section 4@v key 8@v
        0A8C: write_memory 13@ size 4 value 16@ virtual_protect 0

        0008: 12@ += 1
        goto @Cache_Read_Loop
    end
end
return

0000: NOP
script_name "Y_Shake"

wait 1000

// =========================================================================
// YORIGAMI MASTER HEAP DICTIONARY - PRUNED FOR Y_SHAKE
// =========================================================================
const
    MEM_SAVE_SLOT = 0
    MEM_ALLOC_SHAKEDOWN = 52
    MEM_SHION_HANDLE = 116
    MEM_LAST_EXTORTED_PED = 204
    MEM_ACTIVE_MARK = 344
end

:Connect_To_Brain
wait 0
0AAA: 31@ = get_script_struct_named 'Y_Brain'
if
    0039: 31@ == 0 
then
    goto @Connect_To_Brain
end
000A: 31@ += 0x3C 
0A8D: 31@ = read_memory 31@ size 4 virtual_protect 0 
// 31@ holds master shared memory pointer

1@ = -999
16@ = 0  // Marked bounty target handle
17@ = 0  // Marked bounty cash payout
18@ = -1 // Last extorted ped handle
19@ = 0  // Archetype flag: 0 = civil, 1 = gang, 2 = dealer, 3 = criminal
TIMERB = 0

:YShakedown_StartupWait
wait 250
if
    8256: not is_player_playing $PLAYER_CHAR
then
    goto @YShakedown_StartupWait
end

:YShakedown_Loop
wait 50

if
    8256: not is_player_playing $PLAYER_CHAR
then
    goto @YShakedown_Loop
end

01F5: $PLAYER_ACTOR = get_player_actor $PLAYER_CHAR

// Check if Save Slot Changed
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_SAVE_SLOT
0A8D: 0@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
if
    803B: not 0@ == 1@
then
    gosub @YShakedown_ReloadSettings
end

// Read Live Allocated Perks from Shared Memory
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_ALLOC_SHAKEDOWN
0A8D: 2@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0 // Alloc_Shakedown

// =========================================================================
// BOUNTY MONITOR (Hunt down resisting targets)
// =========================================================================
if
    0019: 16@ > 0
then
    if
        056D: actor 16@ defined
    then
        if
            0118: actor 16@ dead
        then
            00A0: store_actor 16@ position_to 21@ 22@ 23@
            000B: 23@ += 0.2

            0085: 26@ = 17@
            0016: 26@ /= 2
            0109: player $PLAYER_CHAR money += 26@
            if
                08B7: test 3@ bit 2 // PlayShakedownSound
            then
                018C: play_sound 1058 at 0.0 0.0 0.0
            end

            0085: 27@ = 26@
            0016: 27@ /= 2

            0087: 24@ = 21@
            000B: 24@ += 0.5
            02E1: 0@ = create_cash_pickup 27@ at 24@ 22@ 23@ permanence_flag 0

            0087: 24@ = 21@
            000F: 24@ -= 0.5
            02E1: 0@ = create_cash_pickup 27@ at 24@ 22@ 23@ permanence_flag 0

            if
                08B7: test 3@ bit 5 // Isolated Bounty Gang Flag (Bit 5 of 3@)
            then
                0998: add_respect 15@

                if and
                    08B7: test 3@ bit 1 // ShowShakedownMessage
                    88B7: not test 3@ bit 7 // Suppress if target was active Mark
                then
                    0ADF: add_text_label "Y_BGANG" text "~y~BOUNTY CLAIMED~n~~g~+$~1~ ~b~(+~1~ RESPECT)"
                    036D: show_text_2numbers_styled GXT 'Y_BGANG' numbers 17@ 15@ time 3000 style 5
                end
            else
                if and
                    08B7: test 3@ bit 1
                    88B7: not test 3@ bit 7 // Suppress if target was active Mark
                then
                    0ADF: add_text_label "Y_BOUNT" text "~y~BOUNTY CLAIMED~n~~g~+$~1~"
                    01E3: show_text_1number_styled GXT 'Y_BOUNT' number 17@ time 3000 style 5
                end
            end

            16@ = 0
            17@ = 0
            08C0: clear 3@ bit 5 // Clear Gang Bounty Flag
            08C0: clear 3@ bit 7 // Clear Mark Bounty Flag
        else
            00A0: store_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR position_to 21@ 22@ 23@
            00A0: store_actor 16@ position_to 24@ 25@ 26@
            050A: 27@ = distance_between_XYZ 21@ 22@ 23@ and_XYZ 24@ 25@ 26@
            if
                0021: 27@ > 75.0
            then
                16@ = 0
                17@ = 0
                08C0: clear 3@ bit 5 // Clear Gang Bounty Flag
                08C0: clear 3@ bit 7 // Clear Mark Bounty Flag
            end
        end
    else
        16@ = 0
        17@ = 0
        08C0: clear 3@ bit 5 // Clear Gang Bounty Flag
        08C0: clear 3@ bit 7 // Clear Mark Bounty Flag
    end
end

// =========================================================================
// SHAKEDOWN INTERACTION (Active if Alloc_Shakedown > 0)
// =========================================================================
if and
    0019: 2@ > 0                          // Has points in Shakedown
    044B: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR on_foot     // Strictly on foot
    TIMERB > 1500                         // Cooldown
    816B: not fading
then
    if
        0AD2: 29@ = player $PLAYER_CHAR targeted_actor
    then
        if and
            056D: actor 29@ defined
            8118: not actor 29@ dead
            044B: actor 29@ on_foot       // Strictly on foot
            87D6: not 29@ == $PLAYER_ACTOR
            803B: not 29@ == 18@
        then
            // Get Ped Model
            0665: get_actor 29@ model_to 27@

            // Read Shion Handle
            0085: 30@ = 31@
            000A: 30@ += MEM_SHION_HANDLE
            0A8D: 0@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

            25@ = 1 // 1 = Valid to shake down

            // Block Special Actors (Models 290 to 299: Shion, Tenpenny, Smoke, etc.)
            if and
                04B5: 27@ >= 290
                04B7: 299 >= 27@
            then
                25@ = 0 // Blocked
            end

            // Block Shion by Handle
            if
                003B: 29@ == 0@
            then
                25@ = 0 // Blocked
            end

            if
                0039: 25@ == 1
            then
                07AF: 25@ = player $PLAYER_CHAR group
                if
                    86EE: not actor 29@ in_group 25@
                then
                    089F: get_actor 29@ pedtype_to 25@
                    if and
                        8039: not 25@ == 6
                        8039: not 25@ == 0
                    then
                        00A0: store_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR position_to 21@ 22@ 23@
                        00A0: store_actor 29@ position_to 24@ 25@ 26@
                        050A: 27@ = distance_between_XYZ 21@ 22@ 23@ and_XYZ 24@ 25@ 26@

                        if
                            0033: 2.8 >= 27@
                        then
                            if
                                0AB0: is_key_pressed 20@ // MainKey (Y)
                            then
                                TIMERB = 0
                                0085: 18@ = 29@

                                // Check if target is the active High-Roller Mark
                                08C0: clear 3@ bit 6
                                0085: 30@ = 31@
                                000A: 30@ += MEM_ACTIVE_MARK
                                0A8D: 25@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
                                if and
                                    0019: 25@ > 0
                                    003B: 29@ == 25@
                                then
                                    08BD: set 3@ bit 6 // Mark shakedown active
                                end

                                // Freeze ambient tasks and request animation immediately
                                0687: clear_actor 29@ task
                                0687: clear_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR task
                                04ED: load_animation "SHOP"

                                // Orient both actors directly towards each other instantly
                                00A0: store_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR position_to 21@ 22@ 23@
                                00A0: store_actor 29@ position_to 24@ 25@ 26@

                                // Ped faces Player
                                0E27: get_angle_from_two_coords 24@ 25@ and 21@ 22@ to 27@
                                0173: set_actor 29@ Z_angle_to 27@

                                // Player faces Ped
                                0E27: get_angle_from_two_coords 21@ 22@ and 24@ 25@ to 27@
                                0173: set_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR Z_angle_to 27@

                                // Lock ped in place so ambient AI cannot turn away while animation loads
                                05B9: AS_actor 29@ stay_idle 1500 ms

                                :YShakedown_AnimWait
                                wait 0
                                if or
                                    8256: not is_player_playing $PLAYER_CHAR
                                    856D: not actor 29@ defined
                                    0118: actor 29@ dead
                                then
                                    04EF: release_animation "SHOP"
                                    goto @YShakedown_Loop
                                end

                                if
                                    84EE: not animation "SHOP" loaded
                                then
                                    goto @YShakedown_AnimWait
                                end

                                // Base loot calculation
                                0209: 28@ = random_int_in_range 4@ 5@

                                // Alloc_Shakedown scaling
                                0085: 26@ = 2@
                                006A: 26@ *= 6@ // Points * BonusPerPoint
                                005A: 28@ += 26@

                                19@ = 0 // Archetype: 0=Civil, 1=Gang, 2=Dealer, 3=Criminal

                                0665: get_actor 29@ model_to 27@
                                if or
                                    27@ == 29
                                    27@ == 30
                                then
                                    005A: 28@ += 7@ // Dealer Bonus
                                    19@ = 2
                                end

                                if
                                    0039: 19@ == 0
                                then
                                    gosub @Check_If_Rich_Ped
                                    if
                                        0039: 25@ == 1
                                    then
                                        005A: 28@ += 8@ // Rich Ped Bonus
                                    end
                                end

                                    0039: 19@ == 0

                                    089F: get_actor 29@ pedtype_to 26@

                                        0039: 26@ == 20

                                        19@ = 3
                                    end
                                end

                                        04B5: 25@ >= 7
                                        04B7: 16 >= 25@
                                        8039: not 25@ == 8
                                    then
                                        19@ = 1
                                    end
                                end

                                // Resistance roll calculation
                                24@ = 0 // Default: Target folds

                                if
                                    0039: 19@ == 1
                                then
                                    0085: 25@ = 2@
                                    0016: 25@ /= 2
                                    0085: 26@ = 10@
                                    0062: 26@ -= 25@ // Current resist chance
                                    0085: 25@ = 26@

                                    if
                                        001D: 11@ > 25@
                                    then
                                        0085: 25@ = 11@ // Clamp to GangMinResistPercent
                                    end

                                    if
                                        002D: 25@ >= 26@
                                    then
                                        24@ = 1 // Target resists
                                    end
                                end

                                if
                                    0039: 19@ == 2
                                then
                                    0209: 26@ = random_int_in_range 1 101
                                    if
                                        002D: 14@ >= 26@
                                    then
                                        24@ = 1 // Target resists
                                    end
                                end

                                if
                                    0039: 19@ == 3
                                then
                                    0085: 25@ = 2@
                                    0016: 25@ /= 2
                                    0085: 26@ = 12@
                                    0062: 26@ -= 25@ // Current resist chance
                                    0085: 25@ = 26@

                                        001D: 13@ > 25@
                                    then
                                        0085: 25@ = 13@ // Clamp to CriminalMinResistPercent
                                    end

                                    0209: 26@ = random_int_in_range 1 101
                                    if
                                        002D: 25@ >= 26@
                                    then
                                        24@ = 1 // Target resists
                                    end
                                end

                                if
                                    0039: 24@ == 1
                                then
                                    04EF: release_animation "SHOP"
                                    0085: 16@ = 29@
                                    0085: 17@ = 28@

                                    then

                                    else
                                        08C0: clear 3@ bit 5
                                    end

                                    if
                                        08B7: test 3@ bit 6
                                    then
                                        08BD: set 3@ bit 7
                                    else
                                        08C0: clear 3@ bit 7
                                    end

                                    05E2: AS_actor 29@ kill_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR

                                    then
                                        018C: play_sound 1057 at 0.0 0.0 0.0
                                    end
                                    if
                                        08B7: test 3@ bit 1
                                    then
                                        0ADF: add_text_label "Y_RESST" text "~r~TARGET RESISTED~n~~w~BOUNTY ISSUED"
                                        00BA: show_text_styled GXT 'Y_RESST' time 2500 style 5
                                    end

                                    08C0: clear 3@ bit 6
                                else
                                    // Branch B: Target Folds
                                    if
                                        0039: 19@ == 2
                                    then
                                        0851: set_actor 29@ decrease_health_by 1 affect_armour 0
                                        0687: clear_actor 29@ task
                                    end

                                    // Lock root motion so ped cannot walk away during animation
                                    0605: actor $PLAYER_ACTOR perform_animation "ROB_Loop_Threat" IFP "SHOP" framedelta 4.0 loop 0 lockX 0 lockY 0 lockF 1 time 2000
                                    0605: actor 29@ perform_animation "SHP_Rob_React" IFP "SHOP" framedelta 4.0 loop 0 lockX 1 lockY 1 lockF 1 time 2000

                                    // Spawn cash burst at victim chest
                                    04C4: store_coords_to 21@ 22@ 23@ from_actor 29@ with_offset 0.0 0.1 0.2

                                    064C: make_particle 25@ visible
                                    064F: remove_references_to_particle 25@

                                    0085: 26@ = 28@
                                    0016: 26@ /= 2
                                    0109: player $PLAYER_CHAR money += 26@
                                    if
                                        08B7: test 3@ bit 2
                                    then
                                        018C: play_sound 1058 at 0.0 0.0 0.0
                                    end

                                    0085: 27@ = 26@
                                    0016: 27@ /= 2

                                    00A0: store_actor 29@ position_to 21@ 22@ 23@
                                    000B: 23@ += 0.2

                                    0087: 24@ = 21@
                                    000B: 24@ += 0.4
                                    02E1: 0@ = create_cash_pickup 27@ at 24@ 22@ 23@ permanence_flag 0

                                    0087: 24@ = 21@
                                    000F: 24@ -= 0.4
                                    02E1: 0@ = create_cash_pickup 27@ at 24@ 22@ 23@ permanence_flag 0

                                    if
                                        0039: 19@ == 1 // Rival Gang Member
                                    then
                                        0998: add_respect 15@

                                        // Query Gang Member Inventory Slots using opcode 04B8
                                        25@ = 0 // Found Model ID
                                        26@ = 0 // Found Weapon ID

                                        // Check Slot 4 (SMG / Tec-9 / Micro-SMG)
                                        04B8: get_weapon_data_from_actor 29@ slot 4 weapon 26@ ammo 27@ model 25@

                                        // Check Slot 5 (Rifle / AK-47 / M4) if no SMG found
                                        if
                                            8019: not 26@ > 1
                                        then
                                            04B8: get_weapon_data_from_actor 29@ slot 5 weapon 26@ ammo 27@ model 25@
                                        end

                                        // Check Slot 3 (Shotgun / Chrome / Sawn-off) if no Rifle found
                                        if
                                            8019: not 26@ > 1
                                        then
                                            04B8: get_weapon_data_from_actor 29@ slot 3 weapon 26@ ammo 27@ model 25@
                                        end

                                        // Check Slot 2 (Pistol) if no Shotgun found
                                        if
                                            8019: not 26@ > 1
                                        then
                                            04B8: get_weapon_data_from_actor 29@ slot 2 weapon 26@ ammo 27@ model 25@
                                        end

                                        // Check Slot 1 (Melee / Knife / Bat) as last fallback
                                        if
                                            8019: not 26@ > 1
                                        then
                                            04B8: get_weapon_data_from_actor 29@ slot 1 weapon 26@ ammo 27@ model 25@
                                        end

                                        // If a weapon was found in their inventory
                                        if
                                            0019: 26@ > 1
                                        then
                                            if
                                                08B7: test 3@ bit 4
                                            then
                                                if
                                                    0019: 25@ > 0
                                                then
                                                    00A0: store_actor 29@ position_to 21@ 22@ 23@
                                                    000B: 23@ += 0.3
                                                    0213: 0@ = create_pickup 25@ type 4 at 21@ 22@ 23@
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end

                                        // Wipe all weapons so they cannot retaliate with weapons
                                        048F: actor 29@ remove_weapons

                                        if and
                                            08B7: test 3@ bit 1
                                            88B7: not test 3@ bit 6
                                        then
                                            0ADF: add_text_label "Y_EGANG" text "~y~GANG EXTORTED~n~~g~+$~1~ ~b~(+~1~ RESPECT)"
                                            036D: show_text_2numbers_styled GXT 'Y_EGANG' numbers 28@ 15@ time 2500 style 5
                                        end
                                    else
                                        if and
                                            08B7: test 3@ bit 1
                                            88B7: not test 3@ bit 6
                                        then
                                            0ADF: add_text_label "Y_EXTOR" text "~y~EXTORTED~n~~g~+$~1~"
                                            01E3: show_text_1number_styled GXT 'Y_EXTOR' number 28@ time 2500 style 5
                                        end
                                    end

                                        8256: not is_player_playing $PLAYER_CHAR
                                    then

                                    end

                                        056D: actor 29@ defined
                                        8118: not actor 29@ dead

                                        05DD: AS_actor 29@ flee_from_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR from_origin_radius 40.0 timelimit 12000

                                        if
                                            08B7: test 3@ bit 6
                                        then
                                            01C2: remove_references_to_actor 29@
                                        end
                                    end

                                    // Sync last extorted ped in master heap now that shakedown finished
                                    0085: 30@ = 31@
                                    000A: 30@ += MEM_LAST_EXTORTED_PED
                                    0A8C: write_memory 30@ size 4 value 18@ virtual_protect 0

                                    00A0: store_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR position_to 21@ 22@ 23@
                                    24@ = 0

                                    if
                                        0AE1: 0@ = random_char_near_point 21@ 22@ 23@ in_radius 18.0 find_next 24@ pass_deads 1
                                    then
                                        24@ = 1
                                        if and
                                            056D: actor 0@ defined
                                            8118: not actor 0@ dead
                                            87D6: not 0@ == $PLAYER_ACTOR
                                            803B: not 0@ == 29@
                                        then
                                            089F: get_actor 0@ pedtype_to 25@
                                            if
                                                0039: 25@ == 6
                                            then
                                                01C0: 25@ = player $PLAYER_CHAR wanted_level
                                                if
                                                    0039: 25@ == 0
                                                then
                                                    010D: set_player $PLAYER_CHAR wanted_level_to 1
                                                    0ADF: add_text_label "Y_CWIT" text "~r~WITNESS ALERT~n~~w~CRIME REPORTED"
                                                    00BA: show_text_styled GXT 'Y_CWIT' time 2000 style 5
                                                    goto @Witness_Scan_End
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                        goto @Witness_Scan_Loop
                                    end
                                    :Witness_Scan_End

                                    TIMERB = 0 // Reset cooldown upon full completion
                                    08C0: clear 3@ bit 6
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

goto @YShakedown_Loop

{$CLEO .c}
{$USE CLEO+}
{$USE memory}
{$USE ini}

0000: NOP
script_name 'Y_AIMTR'

0001: wait 1000 ms

// =========================================================================
// YORIGAMI MASTER HEAP DICTIONARY (TRIMMED)
// =========================================================================
const
    MEM_SAVE_SLOT = 0
    MEM_PLAYER_FORM = 12 // 0 = CJ, 1 = Jo'on, 2 = Shion
end

:Connect_To_Brain
0001: wait 0 ms
0AAA: 31@ = get_script_struct_named 'Y_Brain'
if
    0039: 31@ == 0 
then
    0002: jump @Connect_To_Brain
end

000A: 31@ += 0x3C 
0A8D: 31@ = read_memory 31@ size 4 virtual_protect 0 
if
    0039: 31@ == 0
then
    0002: jump @Connect_To_Brain
end
// 31@ NOW HOLDS THE MASTER POINTER.

1@ = 0 // Alpha State Latch (0 = Normal 255, 1 = Invisible 0)
3@ = -999 // Save Slot Tracker

:YAimAlpha_Loop
0001: wait 10 ms

if
    8256: not player $PLAYER_CHAR defined
then
    0002: jump @YAimAlpha_Loop
end

// Check if Save Slot Changed (for INI reloading)
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_SAVE_SLOT
0A8D: 0@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0
if
    803B: not 0@ == 3@
then
    0050: gosub @YAimAlpha_ReloadSettings
end

01F5: $PLAYER_ACTOR = get_player_actor $PLAYER_CHAR

// Read Live Character State (0 = CJ, 1 = Jo'on, 2 = Shion)
0085: 30@ = 31@
000A: 30@ += MEM_PLAYER_FORM
0A8D: 15@ = read_memory 30@ size 4 virtual_protect 0

// Validate if current form is Jo'on or Shion (CJ gets no special treatment)
2@ = 0
if
    0039: 15@ == 1 // Jo'on
then
    2@ = 1
end

if
    0039: 15@ == 2 // Shion
then
    2@ = 1
end

// Only apply invisibility if the INI setting is enabled (4@ == 1)
if and
    0039: 2@ == 1
    0038: $ONMISSION_Shooting == 1
    0039: 4@ == 1
then
    // Check aiming inputs (RMB / Target Lock)
    0@ = 0
    if or
        0E67: is_aim_button_pressed 0
        00E1: player 0 pressed_key 6
    then
        0@ = 1
    end

    if
        0039: 0@ == 1
    then
        // Make Jo'on or Shion completely invisible while aiming
        if
            0039: 1@ == 0
        then
            0D10: set_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR alpha 0
            1@ = 1
        end
    else
        // Restore full opacity when not aiming down sights
        if
            0039: 1@ == 1
        then
            0D10: set_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR alpha 255
            1@ = 0
        end
    end
else
    // Reset to full opacity if out of range, mission ends, playing as CJ, or INI is disabled
    if
        0039: 1@ == 1
    then
        0D10: set_actor $PLAYER_ACTOR alpha 255
        1@ = 0
    end
end

0002: jump @YAimAlpha_Loop

// =========================================================================
// SUBROUTINES
// =========================================================================
:YAimAlpha_ReloadSettings
0085: 3@ = 0@ // Update tracking variable

4@ = 1 // Default to 1 (Enabled)
0AF0: 4@ = read_int_from_ini_file "cleo\Shion.ini" section "Companion" key "HideModelInShootingRange"

0051: return
